class SettingsSidebar(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self, on_select_callback=None):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=4)
        self.set_size_request(260, -1)
        self.on_select_callback = on_select_callback
        self.rows_map = {}
        self.item_rows = []
        self.separator_rows = []
        self.search_text = ""

        # Search Entry Container
        search_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL)
        search_box.set_margin_start(12)
        search_box.set_margin_end(12)
        search_box.set_margin_top(6)
        search_box.set_margin_bottom(4)

        self.search_entry = Gtk.SearchEntry()
        self.search_entry.set_placeholder_text("Cari pengaturan...")
        self.search_entry.set_hexpand(True)
        self.search_entry.connect("search-changed", self._on_search_changed)
        search_box.append(self.search_entry)
        self.append(search_box)

        # Scrolled Window
        scrolled = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
        scrolled.set_vexpand(True)
        scrolled.set_hexpand(True)
        scrolled.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.NEVER, Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC)

        self.listbox = Gtk.ListBox()
        self.listbox.add_css_class("navigation-sidebar")
        self.listbox.set_selection_mode(Gtk.SelectionMode.SINGLE)
        self.listbox.set_filter_func(self._filter_func)
        self.listbox.connect("row-activated", self._on_row_activated)

        self._build_sidebar()

        scrolled.set_child(self.listbox)
        self.append(scrolled)

    def _build_sidebar(self):
        for idx, group in enumerate(SIDEBAR_GROUPS):
            # Items in this group
            for item in group["items"]:
                row = Gtk.ListBoxRow()
                row.set_selectable(True)
                row.set_activatable(True)
                row.page_id = item["id"]
                row.title = item["title"]
                row.keywords = item["keywords"]
                row.category = group["category"]
                row.is_separator = False

                box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=12)
                box.set_margin_start(8)
                box.set_margin_end(8)
                box.set_margin_top(4)
                box.set_margin_bottom(4)

                icon = Gtk.Image.new_from_icon_name(item["icon"])
                icon.set_pixel_size(16)
                box.append(icon)

                lbl = Gtk.Label(label=item["title"], xalign=0)
                lbl.set_hexpand(True)
                box.append(lbl)

                row.set_child(box)
                self.listbox.append(row)
                self.rows_map[item["id"]] = row
                self.item_rows.append(row)

            # Subtle Divider Separator between groups (except after the last group)
            if idx < len(SIDEBAR_GROUPS) - 1:
                sep_row = Gtk.ListBoxRow()
                sep_row.set_selectable(False)
                sep_row.set_activatable(False)
                sep_row.set_can_focus(False)
                sep_row.set_focusable(False)
                sep_row.set_size_request(-1, 1)
                sep_row.set_can_target(False)
                sep_row.is_separator = True
                sep_row.add_css_class("separator-row")

                sep = Gtk.Box()
                sep.add_css_class("sidebar-separator")
                sep_row.set_child(sep)

                self.listbox.append(sep_row)
                self.separator_rows.append(sep_row)

    def _filter_func(self, row):
        if getattr(row, "is_separator", False):
            # Hide separators completely when searching
            return self.search_text == ""

        if not self.search_text:
            return True

        q = self.search_text.lower()
        if q in row.title.lower() or q in row.category.lower():
            return True
        for kw in row.keywords:
            if q in kw.lower():
                return True
        return False

    def _on_search_changed(self, entry):
        self.search_text = entry.get_text().strip()
        self.listbox.invalidate_filter()

    def _on_row_activated(self, listbox, row):
        if not row or getattr(row, "is_separator", False):
            return
        if self.on_select_callback and hasattr(row, "page_id"):
            self.on_select_callback(row.page_id)

    def select_page(self, page_id):
        if page_id in self.rows_map:
            row = self.rows_map[page_id]
            self.listbox.select_row(row)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
CONFIG_FILE="$HOME/.config/illogical-impulse/config.json"
GUI_LUA="$HOME/.config/hypr/custom/general.lua"
COLORS_LUA="$HOME/.config/hypr/custom/colors.lua"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$GUI_LUA")"

if [[ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
    exit 0
fi

# Parsing values via jq with safe fallbacks
layout=$(jq -r '.hyprland.layout // "dwindle"' "$CONFIG_FILE")

# Celah antar jendela (gaps_in)
gaps_in_adv=$(jq -r '.hyprland.gapsInAdvanced // false' "$CONFIG_FILE")
base_in=$(jq -r '.hyprland.gapsIn // 4' "$CONFIG_FILE")
if [[ "$gaps_in_adv" == "true" ]]; then
    gaps_in_top=$(jq -r ".hyprland.gapsInTop // $base_in" "$CONFIG_FILE")
    gaps_in_right=$(jq -r ".hyprland.gapsInRight // $base_in" "$CONFIG_FILE")
    gaps_in_bottom=$(jq -r ".hyprland.gapsInBottom // $base_in" "$CONFIG_FILE")
    gaps_in_left=$(jq -r ".hyprland.gapsInLeft // $base_in" "$CONFIG_FILE")
    gaps_in="{ top = $gaps_in_top, right = $gaps_in_right, bottom = $gaps_in_bottom, left = $gaps_in_left }"
else
    gaps_in="$base_in"
fi

# Celah ke tepi layar (gaps_out)
gaps_out_adv=$(jq -r '.hyprland.gapsOutAdvanced // false' "$CONFIG_FILE")
base_out=$(jq -r '.hyprland.gapsOut // 10' "$CONFIG_FILE")
if [[ "$gaps_out_adv" == "true" ]]; then
    gaps_out_top=$(jq -r ".hyprland.gapsOutTop // $base_out" "$CONFIG_FILE")
    gaps_out_right=$(jq -r ".hyprland.gapsOutRight // $base_out" "$CONFIG_FILE")
    gaps_out_bottom=$(jq -r ".hyprland.gapsOutBottom // $base_out" "$CONFIG_FILE")
    gaps_out_left=$(jq -r ".hyprland.gapsOutLeft // $base_out" "$CONFIG_FILE")
    gaps_out="{ top = $gaps_out_top, right = $gaps_out_right, bottom = $gaps_out_bottom, left = $gaps_out_left }"
else
    gaps_out="$base_out"
fi

border_size=$(jq -r '.hyprland.borderSize // 2' "$CONFIG_FILE")
resize_on_border=$(jq -r '.hyprland.resizeOnBorder // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
extend_border_grab_area=$(jq -r '.hyprland.extendBorderGrabArea // 15' "$CONFIG_FILE")
hover_icon_on_border=$(jq -r '.hyprland.hoverIconOnBorder // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
allow_tearing=$(jq -r '.hyprland.allowTearing // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")

rounding=$(jq -r '.hyprland.rounding // 10' "$CONFIG_FILE")
rounding_power=$(jq -r '.hyprland.roundingPower // 2.5' "$CONFIG_FILE")
active_opacity=$(jq -r '.hyprland.activeOpacity // 1.0' "$CONFIG_FILE")
inactive_opacity=$(jq -r '.hyprland.inactiveOpacity // 0.95' "$CONFIG_FILE")
dim_inactive=$(jq -r '.hyprland.dimInactive // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
dim_strength=$(jq -r '.hyprland.dimStrength // 0.05' "$CONFIG_FILE")

blur_enabled=$(jq -r '.hyprland.blurEnabled // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
blur_size=$(jq -r '.hyprland.blurSize // 10' "$CONFIG_FILE")
blur_passes=$(jq -r '.hyprland.blurPasses // 2' "$CONFIG_FILE")
blur_noise=$(jq -r '.hyprland.blurNoise // 0.0117' "$CONFIG_FILE")
blur_xray=$(jq -r '.hyprland.blurXray // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
blur_popups=$(jq -r '.hyprland.blurPopups // false' "$CONFIG_FILE")
bar_blur=$(jq -r 'if .bar.blur == false or (.bar.blurStrength // 40) == 0 then "false" else "true" end' "$CONFIG_FILE")

shadow_enabled=$(jq -r '.hyprland.shadowEnabled // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
shadow_range=$(jq -r '.hyprland.shadowRange // 20' "$CONFIG_FILE")
shadow_render_power=$(jq -r '.hyprland.shadowRenderPower // 3' "$CONFIG_FILE")

follow_mouse=$(jq -r '.hyprland.followMouse // 1' "$CONFIG_FILE")
mouse_sensitivity=$(jq -r '.hyprland.mouseSensitivity // 0.0' "$CONFIG_FILE")
touchpad_natural_scroll=$(jq -r '.hyprland.touchpadNaturalScroll // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
touchpad_tap_to_click=$(jq -r '.hyprland.touchpadTapToClick // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
touchpad_disable_while_typing=$(jq -r '.hyprland.touchpadDisableWhileTyping // false' "$CONFIG_FILE")

animations_enabled=$(jq -r '.hyprland.animationsEnabled // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
animate_manual_resizes=$(jq -r '.hyprland.animateManualResizes // false' "$CONFIG_FILE")
animate_mouse_windowdragging=$(jq -r '.hyprland.animateMouseWindowDragging // false' "$CONFIG_FILE")

active_hint=$(jq -r '.hyprland.tiling.activeHint // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
active_hint_block=""
if [[ "$active_hint" == "false" ]]; then
    active_hint_block='        col = {
            active_border = "rgba(1b1b2133)",
        },'
fi

cat <<LUAEOF > "$GUI_LUA"
-- File ini dihasilkan otomatis oleh Quickshell Settings (Hyprland GUI)
hl.config({
    general = {
        layout = "$layout",
        gaps_in = $gaps_in,
        gaps_out = $gaps_out,
        border_size = $border_size,
        resize_on_border = $resize_on_border,
        extend_border_grab_area = $extend_border_grab_area,
        hover_icon_on_border = $hover_icon_on_border,
        allow_tearing = $allow_tearing,
$active_hint_block
    },
    decoration = {
        rounding = $rounding,
        rounding_power = $rounding_power,
        active_opacity = $active_opacity,
        inactive_opacity = $inactive_opacity,
        dim_inactive = $dim_inactive,
        dim_strength = $dim_strength,
        blur = {
            enabled = $blur_enabled,
            size = $blur_size,
            passes = $blur_passes,
            noise = $blur_noise,
            xray = $blur_xray,
            popups = $blur_popups,
        },
        shadow = {
            enabled = $shadow_enabled,
            range = $shadow_range,
            render_power = $shadow_render_power,
        }
    },
    animations = {
        enabled = $animations_enabled,
    },
    input = {
        follow_mouse = $follow_mouse,
        sensitivity = $mouse_sensitivity,
        touchpad = {
            natural_scroll = $touchpad_natural_scroll,
            tap_to_click = $touchpad_tap_to_click,
            disable_while_typing = $touchpad_disable_while_typing,
        }
    },
    misc = {
        animate_manual_resizes = $animate_manual_resizes,
        animate_mouse_windowdragging = $animate_mouse_windowdragging,
    }
})

hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = "quickshell:bar" }, blur = $bar_blur })
hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = "quickshell:bar" }, ignore_alpha = 0.0 })
hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = "quickshell:celestialBezel" }, blur = $bar_blur })
hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = "quickshell:celestialBezel" }, ignore_alpha = 0.5 })
hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = "quickshell:sidebarRight" }, blur = $bar_blur })
hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = "quickshell:sidebarRight" }, ignore_alpha = 0.0 })
hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = "quickshell:sidebarLeft" }, blur = $bar_blur })
hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = "quickshell:sidebarLeft" }, ignore_alpha = 0.0 })
LUAEOF

# Manajemen Warna Border Kustom (Dark & Light Mode)
custom_borders=$(jq -r '.hyprland.customBorders // true' "$CONFIG_FILE")
active_border_dark=$(jq -r '.hyprland.activeBorderDark // "rgba(33ffdcc6)"' "$CONFIG_FILE")
inactive_border_dark=$(jq -r '.hyprland.inactiveBorderDark // "rgba(23191933)"' "$CONFIG_FILE")
active_border_light=$(jq -r '.hyprland.activeBorderLight // "rgba(88f700f7)"' "$CONFIG_FILE")
inactive_border_light=$(jq -r '.hyprland.inactiveBorderLight // "rgba(8839ef33)"' "$CONFIG_FILE")

# Deteksi tema aktif
STATE_FILE="/tmp/current_theme_mode"
if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
    current_mode=$(cat "$STATE_FILE")
else
    raw_scheme=$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme 2>/dev/null | tr -d "'")
    if [ "$raw_scheme" = "prefer-light" ]; then
        current_mode="light"
    else
        current_mode="dark"
    fi
fi

if [[ "$custom_borders" == "true" ]]; then
    if [[ "$current_mode" == "light" ]]; then
        cur_act="$active_border_light"
        cur_inact="$inactive_border_light"
    else
        cur_act="$active_border_dark"
        cur_inact="$inactive_border_dark"
    fi

    cat <<LUAEOF > "$COLORS_LUA"
-- File ini dihasilkan otomatis oleh Pengaturan Desktop (Hyprland GUI)
hl.config({
    general = {
        col = {
            active_border = "$cur_act",
            inactive_border = "$cur_inact",
        },
    },
})
LUAEOF

    # Terapkan langsung ke sesi aktif
    hyprctl keyword general:col.active_border "$cur_act" >/dev/null 2>&1
    hyprctl keyword general:col.inactive_border "$cur_inact" >/dev/null 2>&1
else
    cat <<LUAEOF > "$COLORS_LUA"
-- Warna border kustom dinonaktifkan (mengikuti tema wallpaper dinamis Matugen)
LUAEOF
fi

# Reload Hyprland config seamlessly
hyprctl reload >/dev/null 2>&1

import os
import re
import json
import subprocess
import shutil
import collections

import gi
gi.require_version("Gio", "2.0")
from gi.repository import Gio
from app_detector import AppDetector

CONFIG_PATH = os.path.expanduser("~/.config/illogical-impulse/config.json")
GENERATE_HYPR_SCRIPT = os.path.expanduser("~/.config/hypr/scripts/generate_hypr_gui.sh")
SWITCHWALL_SCRIPT = os.path.expanduser("~/.config/quickshell/ii/scripts/colors/switchwall.sh")

def normalize_keybind_combo(combo: str) -> str:
    """Normalisasi string kombinasi tombol ke bentuk kanonikal (SUPER, CTRL, ALT, SHIFT + key)."""
    if not combo:
        return ""
    c_lower = combo.lower().strip()
    if "tap" in c_lower or ("super_l" in c_lower and "release" in c_lower):
        return "SUPER_TAP"
    parts = [p.strip() for p in combo.split("+")]
    mods = set()
    keys = []
    for p in parts:
        up = p.upper()
        if up in ("SUPER", "SUPER_L", "SUPER_R", "MOD4", "WIN"):
            mods.add("SUPER")
        elif up in ("CTRL", "CONTROL", "CONTROL_L", "CONTROL_R"):
            mods.add("CTRL")
        elif up in ("ALT", "ALT_L", "ALT_R", "MOD1"):
            mods.add("ALT")
        elif up in ("SHIFT", "SHIFT_L", "SHIFT_R"):
            mods.add("SHIFT")
        else:
            keys.append(p.lower())
    canonical_mods = [m for m in ["SUPER", "CTRL", "ALT", "SHIFT"] if m in mods]
    return " + ".join(canonical_mods + sorted(keys))

def normalize_keybind_command(cmd: str) -> str:
    """Normalisasi perintah eksekusi agar perbandingan perintah duplikat akurat."""
    if not cmd:
        return ""
    s = cmd.strip()
    m = re.match(r'^hl\.dsp\.(?:exec_cmd|exec|global)\s*\(\s*["\']?(.*?)["\']?\s*\)$', s, re.DOTALL)
    if m:
        s = m.group(1).strip()
    if s.startswith("exec,"):
        s = s[5:].strip()
    elif s.startswith("exec "):
        s = s[5:].strip()
    if (s.startswith('"') and s.endswith('"')) or (s.startswith("'") and s.endswith("'")):
        s = s[1:-1].strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.strip().lower()

class ConfigBackend:
    def __init__(self):
        self.config_data = {}
        self.last_mtime = 0
        self.load()
        # check_all_configs_health spawns `luac` once per config file, and the
        # health page calls it on every refresh. Remember the verdict per file,
        # keyed by mtime and size, so unchanged files are not re-validated.
        self._config_health_cache = {}

    def _check_and_reload(self):
        if os.path.exists(CONFIG_PATH):
            try:
                mtime = os.path.getmtime(CONFIG_PATH)
                if mtime > self.last_mtime:
                    self.load()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def load(self):
        if os.path.exists(CONFIG_PATH):
            try:
                self.last_mtime = os.path.getmtime(CONFIG_PATH)
                with open(CONFIG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    self.config_data = json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error reading config: {e}")
                self.config_data = {}
        else:
            self.config_data = {}

    def get(self, key_path, default=None):
        self._check_and_reload()
        parts = key_path.split(".")
        curr = self.config_data
        for p in parts:
            if isinstance(curr, dict) and p in curr:
                curr = curr[p]
            else:
                return default
        return curr

    def set(self, key_path, value, auto_apply=True):
        self._check_and_reload()
        parts = key_path.split(".")
        curr = self.config_data
        for p in parts[:-1]:
            if p not in curr or not isinstance(curr[p], dict):
                curr[p] = {}
            curr = curr[p]
        curr[parts[-1]] = value
        self.save()
        if auto_apply and key_path.startswith("hyprland."):
            self.apply_hyprland()

    def save(self):
        try:
            with open(CONFIG_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(self.config_data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
                f.write("\n")
            self.last_mtime = os.path.getmtime(CONFIG_PATH)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error saving config: {e}")

    def get_current_color_scheme(self):
        try:
            res = subprocess.check_output(
                ["gsettings", "get", "org.gnome.desktop.interface", "color-scheme"],
                text=True,
                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL
            ).strip()
            if "dark" in res.lower():
                return "dark"
            return "light"
        except Exception:
            return "dark"

    def apply_hyprland(self):
        if os.path.exists(GENERATE_HYPR_SCRIPT):
            subprocess.Popen(["bash", GENERATE_HYPR_SCRIPT])

    def apply_gtk_theme(self, mode=None):
        # mode: "light", "dark", or None (auto-detect)
        if not mode:
            mode = self.get_current_color_scheme()
        cmd = ["bash", SWITCHWALL_SCRIPT, "--mode", mode, "--noswitch"]
        if os.path.exists(SWITCHWALL_SCRIPT):
            subprocess.Popen(cmd)

    def apply_wallpaper(self, image_path, mode=None):
        if not mode:
            mode = self.get_current_color_scheme()

        switcher.set_policy(Adw.ViewSwitcherPolicy.WIDE)
        switcher.set_halign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        switcher.set_margin_bottom(8)
        self.append(switcher)

        # 1. Tata Letak (Tiling)
        self.stack.add_titled_with_icon(self._build_tiling_page(), "tiling", "Tata Letak", "view-grid-symbolic")

        # 2. Efek Visual
        self.stack.add_titled_with_icon(self._build_effects_page(), "effects", "Efek Visual", "window-maximize-symbolic")

        # 3. Animasi
        self.stack.add_titled_with_icon(self._build_anim_page(), "anim", "Animasi", "system-run-symbolic")

        # 4. Kursor & Touchpad
        self.stack.add_titled_with_icon(self._build_input_page(), "input", "Kursor & Touchpad", "input-mouse-symbolic")

        self.append(self.stack)

    def _build_tiling_page(self):
        box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)

        # Susunan
        layout_grp = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        layout_grp.set_title("Pembagian Layar")

        box.append(layout_grp)

        layout_model = Gtk.StringList.new(["Dwindle (Spiral Otomatis)", "Master (Jendela Utama di Samping)"])
        layout_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title="Gaya Susunan Jendela",
            subtitle="Pilih algoritma penyusunan posisi jendela di layar",

        current_layout = backend.get("hyprland.layout", "dwindle")

        layout_grp.add(layout_row)

        tearing_row = Adw.SwitchRow(

        # Celah

        focus_options = [
            "Klik untuk Mengaktifkan",
            "Fokus Mengikuti Gerakan Kursor",
            "Fokus Terpisah dari Klik",

class LauncherPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_engine_group()
        self._build_gnome_group()
        self._build_dock_group()
        self._build_dock_apps_group()
        self._build_illogical_group()
        self._build_macos_group()
        self._build_timeout_group()

        # Update initial visibility based on saved engine
        self._update_visibility(backend.get("launcher.type", "gnome"))

    def _build_engine_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Mekanisme Peluncur (Launcher Engine)")
        group.set_description("Pilih arsitektur dan gaya antarmuka peluncur aplikasi utama saat tombol pemicu ditekan")
        self.append(group)

        self.engine_types = ["gnome", "illogical", "macos"]
        engine_labels = [
            "GNOME Launcher (Modern)",
            "Illogical Impulse Launcher (Klasik)",
            "macOS Spotlight Launcher (Placeholder)"
        ]

        string_list = Gtk.StringList.new(engine_labels)
        self.engine_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title="Gaya Antarmuka Peluncur",
            subtitle="Pilih paket launcher yang aktif pada sistem",
            model=string_list
        )

        current_engine = backend.get("launcher.type", "gnome")
        if current_engine in self.engine_types:
            self.engine_row.set_selected(self.engine_types.index(current_engine))
        else:
            self.engine_row.set_selected(0)

        self.engine_row.connect("notify::selected", self._on_engine_changed)
        group.add(self.engine_row)

    def _on_engine_changed(self, row, param):
        idx = row.get_selected()
        if 0 <= idx < len(self.engine_types):
            selected_type = self.engine_types[idx]
            backend.set("launcher.type", selected_type)
            self._update_visibility(selected_type)

    def _update_visibility(self, engine_type):
        is_gnome = (engine_type == "gnome")
        self.gnome_group.set_visible(is_gnome)
        self.dock_group.set_visible(is_gnome)
        self.dock_apps_group.set_visible(is_gnome)
        self.illogical_group.set_visible(engine_type == "illogical")
        self.macos_group.set_visible(engine_type == "macos")

    def _build_gnome_group(self):
        self.gnome_group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        self.gnome_group.set_title("Pengaturan GNOME Launcher")
        self.gnome_group.set_description("Konfigurasi interaksi dan tata letak peluncur modern ala GNOME (Carousel, App Grid, dan Pencarian)")
        self.append(self.gnome_group)

        # Default mode upon opening
        mode_labels = [
            "Tinjauan Jendela (Window Carousel)",
            "Kisi Aplikasi Penuh (App Grid)"
        ]
        mode_list = Gtk.StringList.new(mode_labels)
        mode_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title="Tampilan Awal Saat Dibuka",
            subtitle="Antarmuka yang pertama kali muncul saat tombol Super / Super+Space ditekan",
            model=mode_list
        )
        saved_mode = backend.get("launcher.gnome.defaultMode", 0)
        mode_row.set_selected(1 if saved_mode == 1 else 0)
        mode_row.connect("notify::selected", lambda r, p: backend.set("launcher.gnome.defaultMode", int(r.get_selected())))
        self.gnome_group.add(mode_row)

        # App Grid Columns
        cols_val = backend.get("launcher.gnome.appGridColumns", 8)
        cols_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(cols_val), lower=4, upper=12, step_increment=1, page_increment=1)
        cols_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(

            subtitle="Banyaknya kotak ikon aplikasi per baris pada layar penuh Kisi Aplikasi",

        ))
        cols_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("launcher.gnome.appGridColumns", int(r.get_value())))
        self.gnome_group.add(cols_row)

        # App Grid Rows
        rows_val = backend.get("launcher.gnome.appGridRows", 4)

        rows_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Jumlah Baris Kisi Aplikasi",
            subtitle="Banyaknya baris ikon aplikasi per halaman pada layar penuh Kisi Aplikasi",

        ))
        rows_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("launcher.gnome.appGridRows", int(r.get_value())))
        self.gnome_group.add(rows_row)

    def _build_dock_apps_group(self):
        self.dock_apps_group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        self.dock_apps_group.set_title("Aplikasi Default Dock (Favorit Disematkan)")
        self.dock_apps_group.set_description(
            "Daftar aplikasi yang selalu ditampilkan di bilah dock bawah. "
            "Jika jumlah aplikasi default telah memenuhi batas maksimal, aplikasi aktif lain tidak akan menambah ikon baru."
        )

        # Header button to add app
        add_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("list-add-symbolic")
        add_btn.set_tooltip_text("Tambah Aplikasi Default Baru")
        add_btn.add_css_class("flat")
        add_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b: self._show_add_dock_app_dialog())
        self.dock_apps_group.set_header_suffix(add_btn)

        # Max Apps SpinRow
        max_apps_val = backend.get("dock.maxApps", 8)
        max_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(max_apps_val), lower=4, upper=16, step_increment=1, page_increment=2)
        self.max_apps_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Batas Maksimal Aplikasi di Dock",
            subtitle="Batas total slot aplikasi di dock (default + aplikasi aktif)",
            adjustment=max_adj
        ))
        self.max_apps_row.connect("notify::value", self._on_max_apps_changed)
        self.dock_apps_group.add(self.max_apps_row)

        self.append(self.dock_apps_group)
        self.dock_app_rows = []
        self._refresh_dock_apps_list()

    def _refresh_dock_apps_list(self):
        for row in self.dock_app_rows:
            self.dock_apps_group.remove(row)
        self.dock_app_rows.clear()

        pinned = backend.get("dock.pinnedApps", ["kitty"])
        if not pinned:
            empty_row = Adw.ActionRow(
                title="Belum Ada Aplikasi Default",
                subtitle="Klik ikon tambah (+) di sudut kanan atas untuk menyematkan aplikasi ke dock"

**Tool Call: Running view_file**
Status: Completed

            )
            empty_row.set_sensitive(False)
            self.dock_apps_group.add(empty_row)
            self.dock_app_rows.append(empty_row)
            return

        all_apps = AppDetector.get_all_apps()
        app_map = {a["id"].lower(): a for a in all_apps}
        for a in all_apps:
            if a.get("exec"):
                bin_name = a["exec"].split()[0].split("/")[-1].lower()
                if bin_name and bin_name not in app_map:
                    app_map[bin_name] = a

        max_apps = backend.get("dock.maxApps", 8)

        for idx, app_id in enumerate(pinned):
            app_info = app_map.get(app_id.lower())
            title = app_info["name"] if app_info else app_id.capitalize()
            subtitle = f"{app_id} • Posisi {idx + 1}"
            if idx >= max_apps:
                subtitle += " (Melebihi batas maksimal, tidak tampil di dock)"

            row = Adw.ActionRow(title=title, subtitle=subtitle)

            # Prefix icon
            icon_name = app_info.get("icon", "application-x-executable") if app_info else "application-x-executable"
            img = Gtk.Image()
            img.set_pixel_size(24)
            try:
                gicon = Gio.Icon.new_for_string(icon_name)
                img.set_from_gicon(gicon)
            except Exception:
                img.set_from_icon_name("application-x-executable")
            row.add_prefix(img)

            # Suffix button box
            box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=4)
            box.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

            if idx > 0:
                up_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("go-up-symbolic")
                up_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                up_btn.add_css_class("circular")
                up_btn.set_tooltip_text("Geser ke Kiri / Atas")
                up_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, i=idx: self._move_pinned_app(i, -1))
                box.append(up_btn)

            if idx < len(pinned) - 1:
                down_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("go-down-symbolic")
                down_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                down_btn.add_css_class("circular")
                down_btn.set_tooltip_text("Geser ke Kanan / Bawah")
                down_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, i=idx: self._move_pinned_app(i, 1))
                box.append(down_btn)

            del_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("user-trash-symbolic")
            del_btn.add_css_class("flat")
            del_btn.add_css_class("circular")
            del_btn.add_css_class("destructive-action")
            del_btn.set_tooltip_text("Hapus dari Aplikasi Default")
            del_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, i=idx: self._remove_pinned_app(i))
            box.append(del_btn)

            row.add_suffix(box)
            self.dock_apps_group.add(row)
            self.dock_app_rows.append(row)

    def _move_pinned_app(self, idx, direction):
        pinned = list(backend.get("dock.pinnedApps", []))
        new_idx = idx + direction
        if 0 <= new_idx < len(pinned):
            pinned[idx], pinned[new_idx] = pinned[new_idx], pinned[idx]
            backend.set("dock.pinnedApps", pinned)
            self._refresh_dock_apps_list()

    def _remove_pinned_app(self, idx):
        pinned = list(backend.get("dock.pinnedApps", []))
        if 0 <= idx < len(pinned):
            pinned.pop(idx)
            backend.set("dock.pinnedApps", pinned)
            self._refresh_dock_apps_list()

    def _on_max_apps_changed(self, row, param):
        val = int(row.get_value())
        backend.set("dock.maxApps", val)
        self._refresh_dock_apps_list()

        dialog = Adw.MessageDialog(

        search_entry.set_placeholder_text("Cari nama aplikasi...")

        scrolled = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
        scrolled.set_vexpand(True)

        # Tingkat kekuatan blur diatur oleh "Opasitas Latar Belakang Kartu" di
        # atas: makin transparan kartunya, makin terlihat blur di belakangnya.
        # Versi lama menyuntikkan rule untuk namespace lama

        blur_row = Adw.SwitchRow(

    def _on_macos_blur_toggled(self, row, _param):
        is_enabled = row.get_active()
        backend.set("launcher.macos.blur", is_enabled)
        # blurStrength dipertahankan hanya sebagai penanda kompatibilitas
        # (shell versi baru tidak lagi memakainya untuk menghitung opasitas).
        backend.set("launcher.macos.blurStrength", 50 if is_enabled else 0)

    def _build_timeout_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Durasi Kemunculan Pop-up (OSD dan Notifikasi)")
        group.set_description("Waktu tampil indikator volume, kecerahan, dan notifikasi pesan")
        self.append(group)

        # OSD timeout
        osd_val = backend.get("osd.timeout", 1000)
        osd_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(osd_val), lower=500, upper=5000, step_increment=250, page_increment=500)
        osd_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Lama Muncul Kotak Volume dan Kecerahan (ms)",
            subtitle="Berapa milidetik kotak indikator tampil sebelum menghilang otomatis",
            adjustment=osd_adj
        ))
        osd_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("osd.timeout", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(osd_row)

        # Notification timeout
        notif_val = backend.get("notifications.timeout", 7000)
        notif_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(notif_val), lower=1000, upper=15000, step_increment=1000, page_increment=2000)
        notif_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(

import gi
gi.require_version("Gtk", "4.0")

from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend
from widgets import enhance_spin_row

class LockPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_lock_group()

    def _build_lock_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Layar Kunci (Lockscreen)")
        group.set_description("Tampilan keamanan dan privasi saat komputer terkunci")
        self.append(group)

        # Hyprlock vs Quickshell
        backend_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Gunakan Layar Kunci Hyprlock",
            subtitle="Gunakan Hyprlock bawaan yang sangat ringan dan cepat"
        )
        backend_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.useHyprlock", False))
        backend_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.useHyprlock", r.get_active()))
        group.add(backend_row)

        # Blur lockscreen
        blur_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Buramkan Latar Layar Kunci",
            subtitle="Jaga privasi dokumen Anda dengan memburamkan wallpaper saat layar terkunci"
        )
        blur_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.blur.enable", True))
        blur_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.blur.enable", r.get_active()))
        group.add(blur_row)

        # Blur extra zoom
        zoom_val = backend.get("lock.blur.extraZoom", 1.1) * 100
        zoom_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(zoom_val), lower=100, upper=150, step_increment=5, page_increment=10)
        zoom_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Perbesaran Efek Blur Latar (%)",
            subtitle="Tingkat skala pembesaran wallpaper saat efek buram diaktifkan",
            adjustment=zoom_adj
        ))
        zoom_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.blur.extraZoom", round(r.get_value() / 100.0, 2)))
        group.add(zoom_row)

        # Center clock
        center_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Tampilan Jam di Tengah",
            subtitle="Posisikan jam digital besar tepat di tengah layar kunci"
        )
        center_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.centerClock", True))
        center_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.centerClock", r.get_active()))
        group.add(center_row)

        # Show locked text
        locked_text_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Tampilkan Teks Status Terkunci",
            subtitle="Tampilkan tulisan status 'Terkunci' di bagian atas jam layar kunci"
        )
        locked_text_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.showLockedText", True))
        locked_text_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.showLockedText", r.get_active()))
        group.add(locked_text_row)

        # Varied shapes for password dots
        shape_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Bentuk Variasi Titik Karakter Sandi",
            subtitle="Gunakan bentuk geometris variatif untuk menyamarkan karakter kata sandi"
        )
        shape_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.materialShapeChars", True))
        shape_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.materialShapeChars", r.get_active()))
        group.add(shape_row)

        # Password to power
        power_pwd_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Minta Sandi Sebelum Mematikan Komputer",
            subtitle="Cegah orang lain mematikan atau me-restart komputer dari layar kunci"
        )
        power_pwd_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.security.requirePasswordToPower", False))
        power_pwd_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.security.requirePasswordToPower", r.get_active()))
        group.add(power_pwd_row)

        # Unlock keyring
        keyring_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Buka Kunci Keyring Bersamaan",
            subtitle="Buka dompet kunci sandi aplikasi (PAM/GNOME Keyring) saat berhasil masuk sesi"
        )
        keyring_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.security.unlockKeyring", True))
        keyring_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.security.unlockKeyring", r.get_active()))
        group.add(keyring_row)

from backend import backend

class AudioPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_protection_group()
        self._build_sounds_group()

    def _build_protection_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Proteksi Telinga dan Volume")
        group.set_description("Pengamanan dari lonjakan suara mendadak dan pembatasan volume speaker")
        self.append(group)

        # Enable protection
        prot_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Cegah Suara Memekakkan Telinga",
            subtitle="Cegah volume audio melonjak drastis tiba-tiba saat memutar video atau lagu"
        )
        prot_row.set_active(backend.get("audio.protection.enable", False))
        prot_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("audio.protection.enable", r.get_active()))
        group.add(prot_row)

        # Max allowed increase
        inc_val = backend.get("audio.protection.maxAllowedIncrease", 10)
        inc_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(inc_val), lower=1, upper=50, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        inc_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Maksimal Lonjakan Volume Sekali Geser (%)",
            subtitle="Batas tertinggi kenaikan volume dalam satu kali penyesuaian (rekomendasi: 10%)",
            adjustment=inc_adj
        )
        inc_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("audio.protection.maxAllowedIncrease", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(inc_row)

        # Max allowed absolute
        max_val = backend.get("audio.protection.maxAllowed", 99)
        max_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(max_val), lower=50, upper=153, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        max_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Kunci Volume Tertinggi (%)",
            subtitle="Batas mutlak suara speaker agar tidak pernah melampaui persentase ini",
            adjustment=max_adj
        )
        max_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("audio.protection.maxAllowed", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(max_row)

    def _build_sounds_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Suara Pengingat")
        group.set_description("Nada pengingat peristiwa sistem dan timer")
        self.append(group)

        # Battery sound
        bat_sound_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Suara Pasang Pengisi Daya",
            subtitle="Bunyikan nada saat kabel charger dicolok atau dicabut"
        )
        bat_sound_row.set_active(backend.get("sounds.battery", True))
        bat_sound_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("sounds.battery", r.get_active()))
        group.add(bat_sound_row)

        # Pomodoro sound
        pomo_sound_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Suara Bel Pomodoro",
            subtitle="Bunyikan lonceng saat sesi kerja fokus atau waktu istirahat selesai"
        )
        pomo_sound_row.set_active(backend.get("sounds.pomodoro", True))
        pomo_sound_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("sounds.pomodoro", r.get_active()))
        group.add(pomo_sound_row)

import gi

gi.require_version("Adw", "1")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend
from widgets import enhance_spin_row

class PowerPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_warnings_group()
        self._build_suspend_group()

    def _build_warnings_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Pengingat Baterai")
        group.set_description("Notifikasi pengingat kapasitas daya baterai")
        self.append(group)

        # Low warning
        low_val = backend.get("battery.low", 20)
        low_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(low_val), lower=10, upper=40, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        low_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Beri Tahu saat Baterai Mulai Berkurang (%)",
            subtitle="Tampilkan pengingat santai untuk bersiap mencari colokan charger (misal: 20%)",
            adjustment=low_adj
        ))
        low_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.low", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(low_row)

        # Critical warning
        crit_val = backend.get("battery.critical", 5)
        crit_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(crit_val), lower=3, upper=15, step_increment=1, page_increment=2)
        crit_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Peringatan Baterai Hampir Habis (%)",
            subtitle="Peringatan mendesak sebelum laptop kehabisan daya (misal: 5%)",
            adjustment=crit_adj
        ))
        crit_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.critical", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(crit_row)

        # Full charge warning (101 = disabled)
        full_val = backend.get("battery.full", 101)
        full_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(full_val), lower=50, upper=101, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        full_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Pengingat Cabut Charger (%)",
            subtitle="Batas aman perawatan umur baterai (atur ke 101 untuk menonaktifkan)",
            adjustment=full_adj
        ))
        full_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.full", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(full_row)

    def _build_suspend_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Hemat Daya dan Keamanan Data")
        group.set_description("Perlindungan otomatis agar data dan pekerjaan tidak hilang saat baterai habis")
        self.append(group)

        # Automatic suspend switch
        auto_suspend_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Tidur Otomatis saat Baterai Kritis",
            subtitle="Otomatis alihkan komputer ke mode tidur (sleep) sebelum daya mati agar data tidak hilang"
        )
        auto_suspend_row.set_active(backend.get("battery.automaticSuspend", True))
        auto_suspend_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.automaticSuspend", r.get_active()))
        group.add(auto_suspend_row)

        # Suspend threshold
        suspend_val = backend.get("battery.suspend", 3)
        suspend_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(suspend_val), lower=1, upper=10, step_increment=1, page_increment=1)
        suspend_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Batas Baterai untuk Tidur Otomatis (%)",
            subtitle="Komputer akan langsung tidur jika baterai menyentuh angka ini (rekomendasi: 3%)",
            adjustment=suspend_adj
        ))
        suspend_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.suspend", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(suspend_row)

class SearchSafetyPage(Gtk.Box):

        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_search_group()
        self._build_work_safety_group()

    def _build_search_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Pencarian Peluncur Aplikasi")
        group.set_description("Kecerdasan pencocokan kata kunci dan prioritas hasil aplikasi")
        self.append(group)

        # Sloppy search
        sloppy_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Pencarian Toleran Salah Ketik (Typo)",
            subtitle="Aplikasi tetap ditemukan meskipun ada sedikit salah ketik huruf pada nama aplikasi"
        )
        sloppy_row.set_active(backend.get("search.sloppy", False))
        sloppy_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("search.sloppy", r.get_active()))
        group.add(sloppy_row)

        # Delay non-app results
        delay_val = backend.get("search.nonAppResultDelay", 30)
        delay_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(delay_val), lower=0, upper=300, step_increment=10, page_increment=50)
        delay_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Dahulukan Hasil Aplikasi Lokal (ms)",
            subtitle="Jeda waktu pemuatan hasil kalkulator dan web agar daftar aplikasi muncul seketika",
            adjustment=delay_adj
        )
        delay_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("search.nonAppResultDelay", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(delay_row)

    def _build_work_safety_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Penyaringan Konten Sensitif (Privasi)")
        group.set_description("Sensor otomatis konten pribadi saat berada di jaringan umum atau tempat kerja")
        self.append(group)

        # Wallpaper filter
        wall_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Sembunyikan Wallpaper Pribadi di Luar",
            subtitle="Otomatis ganti ke wallpaper netral saat terhubung ke Wi-Fi publik, kantor, atau kampus"
        )
        wall_row.set_active(backend.get("workSafety.enable.wallpaper", True))
        wall_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("workSafety.enable.wallpaper", r.get_active()))
        group.add(wall_row)

        # Clipboard filter
        clip_safe_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Sensor Gambar Pribadi di Riwayat Salin",
            subtitle="Buramkan pratinjau foto sensitif di riwayat papan klip (clipboard)"
        )
        clip_safe_row.set_active(backend.get("workSafety.enable.clipboard", False))
        clip_safe_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("workSafety.enable.clipboard", r.get_active()))
        group.add(clip_safe_row)

    def _build_save_paths_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Folder Penyimpanan Media")
        group.set_description("Lokasi penyimpanan rekaman video dan tangkapan layar (kosongkan jalur screenshot jika hanya ingin menyalin ke papan klip)")
        self.append(group)

        rec_row = Adw.EntryRow(title="Folder Rekaman Video Layar")
        rec_row.set_text(backend.get("screenRecord.savePath", "~/Videos"))
        rec_row.set_show_apply_button(True)
        rec_row.connect("apply", lambda r: backend.set("screenRecord.savePath", r.get_text()))
        group.add(rec_row)

        snip_row = Adw.EntryRow(title="Folder Tangkapan Layar (Screenshot)")
        snip_path = backend.get("screenSnip.savePath", "")
        snip_row.set_text(snip_path)
        snip_row.set_tooltip_text("Kosongkan untuk hanya menyalin hasil tangkapan layar ke papan klip tanpa menyimpan berkas")
        snip_row.set_show_apply_button(True)
        snip_row.connect("apply", lambda r: backend.set("screenSnip.savePath", r.get_text()))
        group.add(snip_row)

class AppearancePage(Gtk.Box):

        self._build_style_group()
        self._build_accent_color_group()
        self._build_transparency_group()

    def _build_style_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Gaya")
        group.set_description("Pilih skema warna dasar untuk jendela dan aplikasi")
        self.append(group)

        # Style Cards Container
        style_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=24)
        style_box.set_halign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        style_box.add_css_class("style-box")

        # 1. Light Card
        self.btn_light = Gtk.Button()
        self.btn_light.add_css_class("style-card")
        self.btn_light.connect("clicked", lambda b: self._select_mode("light"))

        card_box_light = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=8)
        
        # Mockup background
        mock_bg_light = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL)

        mock_bg_light.set_halign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

        mock_win_light = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL)
        mock_win_light.add_css_class("mockup-window-light")
        title_bar_light = Gtk.Box()
        title_bar_light.add_css_class("mockup-titlebar-light")
        mock_win_light.append(title_bar_light)
        mock_bg_light.append(mock_win_light)

        card_box_light.append(mock_bg_light)

        label_light = Gtk.Label(label="Terang")
        label_light.add_css_class("style-card-label")
        card_box_light.append(label_light)

        self.btn_light.set_child(card_box_light)
        style_box.append(self.btn_light)

        # 2. Dark Card

        self.btn_dark.add_css_class("style-card")
        self.btn_dark.connect("clicked", lambda b: self._select_mode("dark"))

        mock_bg_dark = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL)
        mock_bg_dark.add_css_class("mockup-bg-dark")
        mock_bg_dark.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        mock_bg_dark.set_halign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

        mock_win_dark = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL)

        card_box_dark.append(label_dark)

        self.btn_dark.set_child(card_box_dark)
        style_box.append(self.btn_dark)

        style_row = Adw.PreferencesRow()

        self._highlight_card(cur_mode)

        # Auto theme switch - Read-only (Centrally managed by Desktop Wallpapers)
        auto_theme_row = Adw.ActionRow()
        auto_theme_row.set_title("Jadwal Otomatis Tema")
        
        # Read schedule configuration from wallpaper-changer
        light_t = "07:00"
        dark_t = "18:00"
        is_sched_active = True
        try:
            import json, os
            cfg_path = os.path.expanduser("~/.config/wallpaper-changer/config.json")
            if os.path.exists(cfg_path):
                with open(cfg_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    cdata = json.load(f)
                    light_t = cdata.get("theme_light_time", "07:00")
                    dark_t = cdata.get("theme_dark_time", "18:00")
                    is_sched_active = cdata.get("theme_auto_schedule", True)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if is_sched_active:
            auto_theme_row.set_subtitle(f"Dikelola oleh Desktop Wallpapers (Siang {light_t} • Malam {dark_t})")
        else:
            auto_theme_row.set_subtitle("Dikelola oleh Desktop Wallpapers (Jadwal dinonaktifkan)")

        # Read-only indicator switch
        sw_indicator = Gtk.Switch()
        sw_indicator.set_active(is_sched_active)
        sw_indicator.set_sensitive(False)
        sw_indicator.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        sw_indicator.set_tooltip_text("Status jadwal otomatis (Read-Only di Pengaturan ini)")
        auto_theme_row.add_suffix(sw_indicator)

        # Quick access button to open Desktop Wallpapers
        btn_open_app = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("preferences-system-symbolic")
        btn_open_app.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        btn_open_app.add_css_class("flat")
        btn_open_app.set_tooltip_text("Buka Desktop Wallpapers untuk mengubah jadwal")
        btn_open_app.connect("clicked", lambda b: subprocess.Popen(["python3", os.path.expanduser("~/.config/wallpaper-changer/main.py")]))
        auto_theme_row.add_suffix(btn_open_app)

        group.add(auto_theme_row)

    def _select_mode(self, mode):
        self._highlight_card(mode)
        backend.apply_gtk_theme(mode)

    def _highlight_card(self, mode):
        if mode == "light":
            self.btn_light.add_css_class("selected")
            self.btn_dark.remove_css_class("selected")
        else:
            self.btn_dark.add_css_class("selected")
            self.btn_light.remove_css_class("selected")

    def _build_accent_color_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Warna Aksen")
        group.set_description("Pilih warna aksen sistem untuk tombol, penyorot, dan kontrol antarmuka")
        self.append(group)

        # 1. Matugen wallpaper toggle
        self.auto_matugen_row = Adw.SwitchRow()
        self.auto_matugen_row.set_title("Warna Aksen Otomatis dari Wallpaper (Matugen)")
        self.auto_matugen_row.set_subtitle("Ekstrak palet warna Material You secara otomatis setiap kali wallpaper berganti")
        use_wallpaper = backend.get("appearance.palette.useWallpaper", True)
        self.auto_matugen_row.set_active(use_wallpaper)
        group.add(self.auto_matugen_row)

        # 2. Preset Swatches Row
        self.manual_palette_row = Adw.PreferencesRow()
        self.manual_palette_row.set_activatable(False)
        self.manual_palette_row.set_selectable(False)

        swatches_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=10)
        swatches_box.set_halign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        swatches_box.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        swatches_box.set_margin_top(12)

            btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, h=hex_code: self._on_preset_clicked(h))

        init_rgba = Gdk.RGBA()
        if cur_accent and cur_accent.startswith("#") and len(cur_accent) == 7:
            init_rgba.parse(cur_accent)
        else:
            init_rgba.parse("#3584e4")
        self.custom_color_btn.set_rgba(init_rgba)

        self.custom_color_btn.connect("notify::rgba", self._on_custom_color_picked)
        self.custom_color_row.add_suffix(self.custom_color_btn)

        self._update_accent_sensitivity(use_wallpaper)
        self.auto_matugen_row.connect("notify::active", self._on_matugen_toggled)

    def _update_accent_sensitivity(self, use_wallpaper: bool):
        self.manual_palette_row.set_sensitive(not use_wallpaper)
        self.custom_color_row.set_sensitive(not use_wallpaper)

    def _select_accent_swatch(self, hex_color: str):
        found = False
        target = hex_color.lower()

**Tool Call: Running view_file**
Status: Completed

        target = hex_color.lower()
        for btn, code, icon in self.swatch_buttons:
            if code.lower() == target:
                btn.add_css_class("active")
                icon.set_visible(True)
                found = True
            else:
                btn.remove_css_class("active")
                icon.set_visible(False)

        self._custom_color_updating = True
        rgba = Gdk.RGBA()
        if rgba.parse(hex_color):
            self.custom_color_btn.set_rgba(rgba)
        self._custom_color_updating = False

    def _on_matugen_toggled(self, row, param):
        if getattr(self, "_internal_update", False):
            return
        use_wallpaper = row.get_active()
        self._update_accent_sensitivity(use_wallpaper)
        backend.set_use_wallpaper_accent(use_wallpaper)
        if use_wallpaper:
            for btn, _, icon in self.swatch_buttons:
                btn.remove_css_class("active")
                icon.set_visible(False)
        else:
            cur_color = backend.get("appearance.palette.accentColor", "") or "#3584e4"
            self._select_accent_swatch(cur_color)

    def _on_preset_clicked(self, hex_code: str):
        self._select_accent_swatch(hex_code)
        if self.auto_matugen_row.get_active():
            self._internal_update = True
            self.auto_matugen_row.set_active(False)
            self._update_accent_sensitivity(False)
            self._internal_update = False
        backend.apply_accent_color(hex_code)

    def _on_custom_color_picked(self, btn, param):
        if getattr(self, "_custom_color_updating", False):
            return
        rgba = btn.get_rgba()
        hex_code = f"#{int(round(rgba.red * 255)):02x}{int(round(rgba.green * 255)):02x}{int(round(rgba.blue * 255)):02x}"
        if self.auto_matugen_row.get_active():
            self._internal_update = True
            self.auto_matugen_row.set_active(False)
            self._update_accent_sensitivity(False)
            self._internal_update = False
        self._select_accent_swatch(hex_code)
        backend.apply_accent_color(hex_code)

        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()

        self.append(group)

import os

from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw, Gio, GdkPixbuf
from backend import backend

def get_thumbnail_paintable(path, width=80, height=50):
    if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    try:
        pb = GdkPixbuf.Pixbuf.new_from_file_at_scale(path, width, height, True)
        if pb:
            from gi.repository import Gdk
            return Gdk.Texture.new_for_pixbuf(pb)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None

class WallpaperPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_wallpapers_group()
        self._build_parallax_group()

    def refresh_page(self):
        cur_wall = backend.get("background.wallpaperPath", "")
        self.current_row.set_subtitle(cur_wall if cur_wall else "Belum aktif")
        self._update_picture(self.cur_pic, cur_wall)

        light_path = backend.get("background.lightWallpaperPath", "")
        self.light_row.set_subtitle(light_path if light_path else "Belum dipilih (Gunakan bawaan)")
        self._update_picture(self.light_pic, light_path)

        dark_path = backend.get("background.darkWallpaperPath", "")
        self.dark_row.set_subtitle(dark_path if dark_path else "Belum dipilih (Gunakan bawaan)")
        self._update_picture(self.dark_pic, dark_path)

    def _update_picture(self, picture_widget, path):
        paintable = get_thumbnail_paintable(path)
        if paintable:
            picture_widget.set_paintable(paintable)
            picture_widget.set_visible(True)
        else:
            picture_widget.set_visible(False)

    def _build_wallpapers_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Status Wallpaper Layar")

        banner_row = Adw.ActionRow()

        banner_row.set_subtitle("Pengaturan otomatis, urutan, folder, dan koleksi wallpaper kini dikelola oleh aplikasi Wallpaper Changer")
        banner_row.set_icon_name("preferences-desktop-wallpaper-symbolic")

        btn_open_app = Gtk.Button()
        b_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)

        b_img.set_pixel_size(16)
        b_lbl = Gtk.Label(label="Buka Desktop Wallpaper")
        b_box.append(b_img)
        b_box.append(b_lbl)
        btn_open_app.set_child(b_box)
        btn_open_app.add_css_class("suggested-action")
        btn_open_app.add_css_class("pill")
        btn_open_app.connect("clicked", lambda b: subprocess.Popen(["/home/rifqi/.local/bin/wallpaper-changer"]))
        banner_row.add_suffix(btn_open_app)
        group.add(banner_row)

        # Current Active Wallpaper Row (Read-Only Preview)
        self.current_row = Adw.ActionRow()
        self.current_row.set_title("Wallpaper Aktif Saat Ini")
        cur_wall = backend.get("background.wallpaperPath", "")
        self.current_row.set_subtitle(cur_wall if cur_wall else "Belum aktif")

        self.cur_pic.set_size_request(80, 50)

        self.cur_pic.add_css_class("card")
        self._update_picture(self.cur_pic, cur_wall)
        self.current_row.add_suffix(self.cur_pic)
        group.add(self.current_row)

        # Light Wallpaper Row (Read-Only Preview)
        self.light_row = Adw.ActionRow()

import gi
gi.require_version("Gtk", "4.0")
gi.require_version("Adw", "1")
gi.require_version("Pango", "1.0")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw, Gio, GLib, GObject, Pango
from backend import backend

class AppItem(GObject.Object):
    def __init__(self, app_id, name, icon, exec_bin):
        super().__init__()
        self.app_id = app_id
        self.name = name
        self.icon = icon
        self.exec_bin = exec_bin

def _create_app_factory():
    factory = Gtk.SignalListItemFactory()

    def _setup(f, list_item):
        box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=10)
        box.set_margin_top(4)
        box.set_margin_bottom(4)
        box.set_margin_start(4)
        box.set_margin_end(4)

        img = Gtk.Image()
        img.set_pixel_size(24)

        lbl = Gtk.Label(xalign=0)
        lbl.set_ellipsize(Pango.EllipsizeMode.END)

        box.append(img)
        box.append(lbl)
        list_item.set_child(box)

    def _bind(f, list_item):
        item = list_item.get_item()
        if not item:
            return
        box = list_item.get_child()
        img = box.get_first_child()
        lbl = img.get_next_sibling()
        lbl.set_text(item.name)

        icon_str = item.icon or "application-x-executable"
        try:
            gicon = Gio.Icon.new_for_string(icon_str)
            img.set_from_gicon(gicon)
        except Exception:
            img.set_from_icon_name("application-x-executable")

    factory.connect("setup", _setup)
    factory.connect("bind", _bind)
    return factory


class DefaultAppsPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self.is_loading = False
        self.cat_defs = {}
        self.groups_widgets = {}
        self.rows_widgets = {}

        self._build_category_groups()
        GLib.idle_add(lambda: self._load_data(force_reload=False) or False)

    def _build_category_groups(self):
        group_specs = [
            ("core", "Aplikasi Utama", "Terminal, peramban web, dan pengelola berkas"),
            ("productivity", "Dokumen & Teks", "Pengolah kata, editor teks, kode, lembar sebar, dan presentasi"),
            ("media", "Multimedia", "Foto, rekaman video, dan pemutar musik"),
            ("utility", "Utilitas", "Pengelola arsip kompresi dan surel")
        ]

        for idx, (gid, gtitle, gdesc) in enumerate(group_specs):
            group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
            group.set_title(GLib.markup_escape_text(gtitle))
            group.set_description(GLib.markup_escape_text(gdesc))

            # Tombol Segarkan di pojok kanan judul grup pertama
            if idx == 0:
                self.refresh_btn = Gtk.Button()
                self.refresh_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                self.refresh_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                refresh_btn_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)
                refresh_icon = Gtk.Image.new_from_icon_name("view-refresh-symbolic")
                self.refresh_label = Gtk.Label(label="Segarkan")
                refresh_btn_box.append(refresh_icon)
                refresh_btn_box.append(self.refresh_label)
                self.refresh_btn.set_child(refresh_btn_box)
                self.refresh_btn.set_tooltip_text("Pindai ulang aplikasi terpasang di sistem")
                self.refresh_btn.connect("clicked", self._on_refresh_clicked)
                group.set_header_suffix(self.refresh_btn)

    def _build_user_execs_group(self):
        self.user_group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        self.user_group.set_title("Aplikasi Startup Pengguna")
        self.user_group.set_description("Program yang dijalankan secara otomatis saat Anda masuk ke sesi desktop")

        # Header bar button
        add_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("list-add-symbolic")
        add_btn.set_tooltip_text("Tambah Aplikasi Startup Baru")
        add_btn.add_css_class("flat")
        add_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b: self._show_add_dialog())
        self.user_group.set_header_suffix(add_btn)

        self.append(self.user_group)
        self._refresh_user_rows()

    def _refresh_user_rows(self):
        for row in self.user_rows:
            self.user_group.remove(row)
        self.user_rows.clear()

        execs = backend.get_execs()
        if not execs:
            empty_row = Adw.ActionRow(
                title="Belum Ada Aplikasi Startup Kustom",
                subtitle="Klik tombol tambah (+) di sudut kanan atas untuk menambahkan aplikasi"
            )
            empty_row.set_sensitive(False)
            self.user_group.add(empty_row)
            self.user_rows.append(empty_row)
            return

        for idx, item in enumerate(execs):
            row = Adw.ActionRow(
                title=item.get("name", "Aplikasi"),
                subtitle=item.get("command", "")
            )

            # Switch enable/disable
            sw = Gtk.Switch()
            sw.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
            sw.set_active(item.get("enabled", True))
            sw.connect("notify::active", self._make_toggle_callback(idx))
            row.add_suffix(sw)

            # Action button box
            btn_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=4)
            btn_box.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

            # Edit button
            edit_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("document-edit-symbolic")
            edit_btn.add_css_class("flat")
            edit_btn.add_css_class("circular")
            edit_btn.set_tooltip_text("Edit Aplikasi Startup")
            edit_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, i=idx: self._show_edit_dialog(i))
            btn_box.append(edit_btn)

            # Delete button
            del_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("user-trash-symbolic")
            del_btn.add_css_class("flat")
            del_btn.add_css_class("circular")
            del_btn.add_css_class("destructive-action")
            del_btn.set_tooltip_text("Hapus dari Autostart")
            del_btn.connect("clicked", self._make_delete_callback(idx))

from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend

class EnvPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=20)
        self.set_margin_top(24)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self.env_data = backend.get_env()

        self._build_cursor_group()
        self._build_gpu_group()
        self._build_custom_vars_group()

    def refresh_page(self):
        self.env_data = backend.get_env()
        self._refresh_custom_vars()

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. KURSOR & ANTARMUKA
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_cursor_group(self):
        grp = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        grp.set_title("Kursor dan Toolkit Aplikasi")
        grp.set_description("Pengaturan ukuran kursor dan kompatibilitas Wayland untuk aplikasi Electron dan browser")
        self.append(grp)

        # Cursor size
        cur_size = self.env_data.get("xcursor_size", 24)
        cursor_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(cur_size), lower=16, upper=64, step_increment=4, page_increment=8)
        cursor_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Ukuran Penunjuk Kursor",
            subtitle="Besar kursor mouse di semua jendela aplikasi (piksel)",
            adjustment=cursor_adj
        )
        cursor_row.connect("notify::value", self._on_cursor_size_changed)
        grp.add(cursor_row)

        # Electron Ozone Hint
        el_options = ["Otomatis (auto)", "Paksa Wayland (wayland)"]
        el_model = Gtk.StringList.new(el_options)
        el_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title="Platform Aplikasi Electron",
            subtitle="Mendukung aplikasi seperti VS Code, Discord, dan Spotify",
            model=el_model
        )
        cur_el = self.env_data.get("electron_platform", "auto")
        el_row.set_selected(0 if cur_el == "auto" else 1)
        el_row.connect("notify::selected", self._on_electron_changed)
        grp.add(el_row)

        # Moz Wayland
        moz_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Akselerasi Wayland pada Firefox",
            subtitle="Gunakan backend Wayland murni untuk Firefox agar rendering lebih hemat daya"
        )
        moz_row.set_active(self.env_data.get("moz_wayland", True))
        moz_row.connect("notify::active", self._on_moz_changed)
        grp.add(moz_row)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. AKSELERASI GPU
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_gpu_group(self):
        grp = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        grp.set_title("Akselerasi Perangkat Keras GPU")
        grp.set_description("Driver decoding video perangkat keras (VA-API)")
        self.append(grp)

        drivers = [
            ("Intel Iris Xe / Gen 8+ (iHD)", "iHD"),
            ("AMD Radeon (radeonsi)", "radeonsi"),
            ("NVIDIA Proprietary (nvidia)", "nvidia"),
            ("Deteksi Otomatis Sistem", "auto")
        ]
        driver_model = Gtk.StringList.new([d[0] for d in drivers])
        driver_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title="Driver Akselerasi Video (LIBVA)",
            subtitle="Optimalkan pemutaran video beresolusi tinggi dengan konsumsi CPU rendah",
            model=driver_model
        )

        cur_driver = self.env_data.get("libva_driver", "iHD")
        sel_idx = 0
        for idx, (_, val) in enumerate(drivers):
            if val == cur_driver:
                sel_idx = idx
                break
        driver_row.set_selected(sel_idx)

        def on_driver_changed(row, param):
            idx = row.get_selected()
            self.env_data["libva_driver"] = drivers[idx][1]
            backend.save_env(self.env_data)

import gi
gi.require_version("Gtk", "4.0")
gi.require_version("Adw", "1")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw, GLib, Gdk


class NumericSlider(Gtk.Box):
    """
    Komponen slider horizontal yang dilengkapi dengan kotak angka interaktif (editable pill).
    Pengguna dapat menggeser slider secara visual ATAU langsung mengklik angka untuk mengetik
    nilai yang diinginkan secara presisi.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        adjustment: Gtk.Adjustment,
        suffix: str = "%",
        digits: int = 0,
        min_width: int = 170,
        zero_label: str = None,
        tooltip_entry: str = "Klik untuk mengetik angka langsung (tekan Enter untuk menerapkan)",
        tooltip_scale: str = "Geser untuk menyesuaikan nilai"
    ):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=10)
        self.adjustment = adjustment
        self.suffix_text = suffix
        self.digits = digits
        self.zero_label = zero_label
        self._is_editing = False

        self.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

        # 1. Slider (Gtk.Scale)
        self.scale = Gtk.Scale(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, adjustment=adjustment)
        self.scale.set_draw_value(False)  # Nilai angka digambar oleh interactive entry
        self.scale.set_size_request(min_width, -1)
        self.scale.set_hexpand(True)
        self.scale.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        if tooltip_scale:
            self.scale.set_tooltip_text(tooltip_scale)
        self.append(self.scale)

        # 2. Interactive Numeric Pill Entry
        self.entry = Gtk.Entry()
        self.entry.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        self.entry.set_alignment(0.5)
        self.entry.set_max_width_chars(8)
        self.entry.set_width_chars(6)
        self.entry.add_css_class("numeric-pill-entry")
        if tooltip_entry:
            self.entry.set_tooltip_text(tooltip_entry)
        self.append(self.entry)

        # Sinkronisasi nilai awal
        self._update_display()

        # Listeners
        self.adjustment.connect("value-changed", self._on_adj_value_changed)
        self.entry.connect("activate", self._on_entry_activate)

        # Focus controller untuk inline editing
        focus_ctrl = Gtk.EventControllerFocus()
        focus_ctrl.connect("enter", self._on_focus_enter)
        focus_ctrl.connect("leave", self._on_focus_leave)
        self.entry.add_controller(focus_ctrl)

        # Keyboard controller (Escape untuk batal)
        key_ctrl = Gtk.EventControllerKey()
        key_ctrl.connect("key-pressed", self._on_key_pressed)
        self.entry.add_controller(key_ctrl)

    def _format_value(self, val: float) -> str:
        if self.zero_label and round(val, self.digits) == 0:
            return self.zero_label
        if self.digits == 0:
            num_str = str(int(round(val)))
        else:
            num_str = f"{val:.{self.digits}f}"
        return f"{num_str}{self.suffix_text}" if self.suffix_text else num_str

    def _update_display(self):
        if not self._is_editing:
            self.entry.set_text(self._format_value(self.adjustment.get_value()))

    def _on_adj_value_changed(self, adj):
        if not self._is_editing:
            self._update_display()

    def _select_all_text(self):
        if self._is_editing:
            self.entry.select_region(0, -1)
        return False

    def _on_focus_enter(self, controller):
        self._is_editing = True
        val = self.adjustment.get_value()
        if self.digits == 0:
            raw_text = str(int(round(val)))
        else:
            raw_text = f"{val:.{self.digits}f}"
        self.entry.set_text(raw_text)

```
# Panduan Desain Antarmuka GTK & Libadwaita (GTK HIG Guide)

Dokumen ini adalah standar resmi dan panduan gaya desain (*Human Interface Guidelines* / HIG) untuk aplikasi **Pengaturan Desktop (`settings-gtk`)**. Panduan ini mengadaptasi prinsip dasar GNOME HIG dan filosofi desain Libadwaita dengan penekanan pada **minimalisme**, **simplifikasi**, dan **keterbacaan instan**.

---

## 1. Filosofi Inti

1. **Minimalisme & Keringkasan Teks**
   - Setiap elemen antarmuka harus bernilai dan fungsional.
   - Hindari teks bertele-tele (*verbosity*), penjelasan teknis yang berbelit-belit, atau kalimat instruksional yang jelas terlihat dari fungsinya.
   - Sampaikan maksud dalam frasa sesingkat mungkin tanpa mengorbankan kejelasan.

2. **Self-Explanatory Controls**
   - Jika sebuah saklar atau kontrol sudah jelas fungsinya dari judulnya, **jangan gunakan subjudul (*subtitle*)**.
   - Subjudul hanya ditambahkan jika ada konteks krusial atau dampak penting yang tidak tampak dari judulnya saja.

3. **Kejelasan Bahasa & Tipografi**
   - Gunakan Bahasa Indonesia standar yang wajar, profesional, dan setara dengan terjemahan resmi GNOME / Fedora / Ubuntu.
   - **Haramkan redundansi bilingual dalam kurung** seperti `Celah (Gaps)`, `Sisi Atas (Top)`, `Layar Kunci (Lockscreen)`, atau `Dermaga (Dock)`. Pilih istilah bahasa Indonesia yang lugas atau istilah industri yang sudah baku (misal: *Dock*, *Blur*, *Touchpad*).

---

## 2. Hirarki dan Struktur Komponen

Aplikasi pengaturan dibangun di atas fondasi hierarkis Libadwaita:

```
Adw.NavigationSplitView
 ├── Sidebar (Adw.NavigationPage -> Gtk.ListBox)
 └── Content (Adw.NavigationPage -> Adw.ToolbarView)
      └── Adw.PreferencesPage / Gtk.ScrolledWindow
           └── Adw.PreferencesGroup
                ├── Adw.ActionRow
                ├── Adw.SwitchRow
                ├── Adw.SpinRow / NumericSliderRow
                ├── Adw.ComboRow
                ├── Adw.EntryRow
                └── Adw.ExpanderRow
```

### A. Penggunaan `Adw.PreferencesGroup`
- **Judul Grup (`set_title`)**:
  - Wajib ringkas (1–3 kata). Contoh: `Tata Letak`, `Celah`, `Bingkai`, `Efek Visual`.
- **Deskripsi Grup (`set_description`)**:
  - **JANGAN** memberi deskripsi pada grup jika judul grup sudah cukup jelas.
  - Deskripsi hanya diperbolehkan jika ada peringatan (*warning*), dependensi sistem, atau catatan teknis yang benar-benar memerlukan penjelasan tambahan.

### B. Pemilihan Widget Baris

| Tipe Data / Aksi | Widget yang Digunakan | Rekomendasi HIG |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Boolean On/Off** | `Adw.SwitchRow` | Saklar berada di sisi kanan. Langsung menerapkan perubahan. |
| **Pilihan Tunggal (2–6 opsi)** | `Adw.ComboRow` | Dropdown bersih dengan label ringkas. |
| **Pilihan Warna** | `Adw.ActionRow` + `Gtk.ColorDialogButton` | Dialog pemilih warna modern GTK4. |
| **Nilai Numerik Diskrit** | `Adw.SpinRow` / `enhance_spin_row` | Tombol `+` / `-` yang mendukung ketik langsung. |
| **Nilai Persentase / Rentang** | `NumericSliderRow` | Slider visual dengan pill angka yang dapat diketik langsung. |
| **Teks / Jalur Berkas** | `Adw.EntryRow` | Dilengkapi tombol simpan (*apply button*). |
| **Pengaturan Lanjutan / Sisi** | `Adw.ExpanderRow` | Dapat dibuka-tutup untuk menyembunyikan detail sekunder. |

---

## 3. Standar Penulisan Judul & Subjudul

### Pola Sebelum vs Sesudah (Anti-Pattern vs HIG)

| Sebelum (Buruk / Verbose) | Sesudah (Standar HIG) | Alasan Perubahan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Sisi Atas (Top)`<br>`sub: Jarak celah antar jendela bagian atas (px)` | `Atas` | Judul mandiri dalam expander celah; subjudul dihapus karena redundan. |
| `Tarik Garis Tepi untuk Ubah Ukuran`<br>`sub: Cukup seret garis tepi jendela untuk memperbesar atau memperkecil` | `Ubah Ukuran pada Garis Tepi` | Menghapus kata berbunga-bunga; judul langsung to-the-point. |
| `Tingkat Kelengkungan Sudut (Corner Radius)` | `Radius Sudut` | Menghilangkan kurung bilingual dan frasa panjang. |
| `Beri Bayangan Melayang`<br>`sub: Menambahkan efek bayangan lembut di sekeliling jendela` | `Bayangan Jendela`<br>`sub: Efek bayangan di sekeliling jendela` | Judul deklaratif, subjudul ringkas. |
| `macOS Spotlight Launcher (Placeholder)` | `macOS Launchpad` | Mengganti placeholder yang salah dengan nama fungsionalitas aslinya. |
| `Jeda Ketukan Ganda Super (ms)`<br>`sub: Batas waktu jeda ketukan ganda tombol Super...` | `Jeda Ketukan Ganda Super`<br>`sub: Batas waktu antar ketukan tombol Super` | Satuan (ms) cukup di spin row / input, tidak perlu mengulang judul di subjudul. |

---

## 4. Standar Terminologi Bahasa Indonesia

Gunakan padanan kata resmi berikut secara konsisten:

| Istilah Teknis | Terjemahan Standar | Hindari Penggunaan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Workspace** | Ruang Kerja | Desktop virtual, lembar kerja |
| **Gaps** | Celah | Spasi, jarak kosong |
| **Gaps In** | Celah Antar Jendela | Spasi dalam |
| **Gaps Out** | Celah ke Tepi Layar | Spasi luar |
| **Border** | Garis Tepi / Bingkai | Outline, pinggiran |
| **Rounding** | Radius Sudut | Lengkungan, kebulatan |
| **Opacity** | Opasitas | Kepekatan, ketebalan warna |
| **Blur** | Blur | Efek buram artistik |
| **Lockscreen** | Layar Kunci | Kunci layar, screenlock |
| **Autostart / Execs** | Aplikasi Startup | Aplikasi mulai otomatis |
| **Environment Variables**| Variabel Sesi | Variabel lingkungan |
| **Overview** | Tinjauan Jendela | Tinjauan |
| **App Grid** | Kisi Aplikasi | Grid aplikasi |
| **Suspend** | Tidur / Suspensi | Mode tidur nyenyak |
| **Zoom (Maximize)** | Zoom (Maksimalkan) | Pembesaran |

---

## 5. Arsitektur & Sinkronisasi Konfigurasi

Semua interaksi antarmuka dihubungkan ke berkas konfigurasi melalui `backend.py`:

```
UI Widget (Gtk/Adw)
       │
       ▼ (Event Handler)
  backend.set("key.path", value)
       │
       ├── Menulis ke ~/.config/illogical-impulse/config.json
       │
       └── [Jika diawali "hyprland."]
             ├── Menjalankan generate_hypr_gui.sh
             ├── Memperbarui custom/general.lua & custom/colors.lua
             └── Menjalankan `hyprctl reload`
```

### Aturan Penerapan:
1. **Penerapan Instan (*Auto-Apply*)**: Kontrol visual (seperti ukuran celah, border, opasitas, tema bar) harus diterapkan seketika tanpa mengharuskan pengguna menekan tombol "Simpan" terpisah.
2. **Kemandirian Berkas Manual**: Jangan menulis atau mengotak-atik berkas konfigurasi manual pengguna (`hyprland/keybinds.lua`, `hyprland.lua`). GUI hanya mengelola berkas turunannya di `custom/`.
3. **Penyaringan Kesalahan**: Tangani kegagalan eksternal (misal: jika aplikasi pendukung tidak terpasang) dengan pesan informatif yang tidak memblokir aplikasi utama.

```

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    def _on_layout_changed(self, row, param):
        val = "dwindle" if row.get_selected() == 0 else "master"
        backend.set("hyprland.layout", val)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _update_int(self, key, val):
