        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _update_float(self, key, val, digits=2):
        backend.set(key, round(float(val), digits))
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _update_bool(self, key, val):
        backend.set(key, bool(val))
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_gaps_in_adv_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_enable_expansion()
        backend.set("hyprland.gapsInAdvanced", is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_gaps_out_adv_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_enable_expansion()
        backend.set("hyprland.gapsOutAdvanced", is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_custom_borders_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_active()
        backend.set("hyprland.customBorders", is_active)
        for r in self.border_color_rows:
            r.set_sensitive(is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _create_color_row(self, title, subtitle, key, default_val):
        row = Adw.ActionRow(title=title, subtitle=subtitle)
        color_dialog = Gtk.ColorDialog()
        color_dialog.set_title(title)
        color_dialog.set_with_alpha(True)

        btn = Gtk.ColorDialogButton(dialog=color_dialog)
        btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

        cur_val = backend.get(key, default_val)
        init_rgba = self._parse_hypr_color(cur_val)
        btn.set_rgba(init_rgba)

        def on_color_picked(button, param):
            rgba = button.get_rgba()
            hypr_color = self._rgba_to_hypr_color(rgba)
            backend.set(key, hypr_color)
            backend.apply_hyprland()

        btn.connect("notify::rgba", on_color_picked)
        row.add_suffix(btn)
        return row, btn

    def _on_reset_border_colors(self, button):
        defaults = {
            "hyprland.activeBorderDark": "rgba(33ffdcc6)",
            "hyprland.activeBorderLight": "rgba(88f700f7)",
            "hyprland.inactiveBorderDark": "rgba(23191933)",
            "hyprland.inactiveBorderLight": "rgba(8839ef33)",
        }
        for k, v in defaults.items():
            backend.set(k, v)

        self.btn_act_dark.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.activeBorderDark"]))
        self.btn_act_light.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.activeBorderLight"]))
        self.btn_inact_dark.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.inactiveBorderDark"]))
        self.btn_inact_light.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.inactiveBorderLight"]))

        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _parse_hypr_color(self, color_str):
        if not color_str:
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=0.5, green=0.5, blue=0.5, alpha=1.0)
        s = str(color_str).strip()
        if s.startswith("rgba(") and s.endswith(")"):
            hex_val = s[5:-1]
        elif s.startswith("rgb(") and s.endswith(")"):
            hex_val = s[4:-1]
        elif s.startswith("#"):
            hex_val = s[1:]
        elif s.startswith("0x"):
            hex_val = s[2:]
        else:
            hex_val = s

        if len(hex_val) == 8:
            r = int(hex_val[0:2], 16) / 255.0
            g = int(hex_val[2:4], 16) / 255.0
            b = int(hex_val[4:6], 16) / 255.0
            a = int(hex_val[6:8], 16) / 255.0
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=r, green=g, blue=b, alpha=a)
        elif len(hex_val) == 6:
            r = int(hex_val[0:2], 16) / 255.0
            g = int(hex_val[2:4], 16) / 255.0
            b = int(hex_val[4:6], 16) / 255.0
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=r, green=g, blue=b, alpha=1.0)
        else:
            c = Gdk.RGBA()
            if c.parse(color_str):
                return c
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=0.2, green=1.0, blue=0.86, alpha=0.78)

    def _rgba_to_hypr_color(self, rgba):
        r = int(round(rgba.red * 255))
        g = int(round(rgba.green * 255))
        b = int(round(rgba.blue * 255))
        a = int(round(rgba.alpha * 255))
        return f"rgba({r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}{a:02x})"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # HELPERS
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_layout_changed(self, row, param):
        val = "dwindle" if row.get_selected() == 0 else "master"
        backend.set("hyprland.layout", val)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _update_int(self, key, val):
        backend.set(key, int(val))
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _update_float(self, key, val, digits=2):
        backend.set(key, round(float(val), digits))
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _update_bool(self, key, val):
        backend.set(key, bool(val))
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_gaps_in_adv_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_enable_expansion()
        backend.set("hyprland.gapsInAdvanced", is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_gaps_out_adv_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_enable_expansion()
        backend.set("hyprland.gapsOutAdvanced", is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_custom_borders_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_active()
        backend.set("hyprland.customBorders", is_active)
        for r in self.border_color_rows:
            r.set_sensitive(is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _create_color_row(self, title, subtitle, key, default_val):
        row = Adw.ActionRow(title=title)
        if subtitle:
            row.set_subtitle(subtitle)
        color_dialog = Gtk.ColorDialog()
        color_dialog.set_title(title)
        color_dialog.set_with_alpha(True)

        btn = Gtk.ColorDialogButton(dialog=color_dialog)
        btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

        cur_val = backend.get(key, default_val)
        init_rgba = self._parse_hypr_color(cur_val)
        btn.set_rgba(init_rgba)

        def on_color_picked(button, param):
            rgba = button.get_rgba()
            hypr_color = self._rgba_to_hypr_color(rgba)
            backend.set(key, hypr_color)
            backend.apply_hyprland()

        btn.connect("notify::rgba", on_color_picked)
        row.add_suffix(btn)
        return row, btn

    def _on_reset_border_colors(self, button):
        defaults = {
            "hyprland.activeBorderDark": "rgba(33ffdcc6)",
            "hyprland.activeBorderLight": "rgba(88f700f7)",
            "hyprland.inactiveBorderDark": "rgba(23191933)",
            "hyprland.inactiveBorderLight": "rgba(8839ef33)",
        }
        for k, v in defaults.items():
            backend.set(k, v)

        self.btn_act_dark.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.activeBorderDark"]))
        self.btn_act_light.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.activeBorderLight"]))
        self.btn_inact_dark.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.inactiveBorderDark"]))
        self.btn_inact_light.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.inactiveBorderLight"]))

        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _parse_hypr_color(self, color_str):
        if not color_str:
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=0.5, green=0.5, blue=0.5, alpha=1.0)
        s = str(color_str).strip()
        if s.startswith("rgba(") and s.endswith(")"):
            hex_val = s[5:-1]
        elif s.startswith("rgb(") and s.endswith(")"):
            hex_val = s[4:-1]
        elif s.startswith("#"):
            hex_val = s[1:]
        elif s.startswith("0x"):
            hex_val = s[2:]
        else:
            hex_val = s

        if len(hex_val) == 8:
            r = int(hex_val[0:2], 16) / 255.0
            g = int(hex_val[2:4], 16) / 255.0
            b = int(hex_val[4:6], 16) / 255.0
            a = int(hex_val[6:8], 16) / 255.0
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=r, green=g, blue=b, alpha=a)
        elif len(hex_val) == 6:
            r = int(hex_val[0:2], 16) / 255.0
            g = int(hex_val[2:4], 16) / 255.0
            b = int(hex_val[4:6], 16) / 255.0
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=r, green=g, blue=b, alpha=1.0)
        else:
            c = Gdk.RGBA()
            if c.parse(color_str):
                return c
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=0.2, green=1.0, blue=0.86, alpha=0.78)

    def _rgba_to_hypr_color(self, rgba):
        r = int(round(rgba.red * 255))
        g = int(round(rgba.green * 255))
        b = int(round(rgba.blue * 255))
        a = int(round(rgba.alpha * 255))
        return f"rgba({r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}{a:02x})"

        box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)

        )
        master_row.set_active(backend.get(\"hyprland.animationsEnabled\", True))
        master_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: self._update_bool(\"hyprland.animationsEnabled\", r.get_active()))
        anim_grp.add(master_row)

        resize_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Animasi Ubah Ukuran\"
        )
        resize_row.set_active(backend.get(\"hyprland.animateManualResizes\", False))
        resize_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: self._update_bool(\"hyprland.animateManualResizes\", r.get_active()))
        anim_grp.add(resize_row)

        drag_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Animasi Seret Jendela\"
        )
        drag_row.set_active(backend.get(\"hyprland.animateMouseWindowDragging\", False))
        drag_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: self._update_bool(\"hyprland.animateMouseWindowDragging\", r.get_active()))
        anim_grp.add(drag_row)

        return box

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. KURSOR & TOUCHPAD
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_input_page(self):
        box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)

        mouse_grp = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        mouse_grp.set_title(\"Tetikus (Mouse)\")
        box.append(mouse_grp)

        focus_options = [
            \"Klik untuk Fokus\",
            \"Fokus Mengikuti Kursor\",
            \"Fokus Terpisah dari Klik\",
            \"Kursor Terkunci pada Jendela\"
        ]
        focus_model = Gtk.StringList.new(focus_options)
        focus_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title=\"Fokus Jendela\",
            model=focus_model
        )
        current_focus = backend.get(\"hyprland.followMouse\", 1)
        if isinstance(current_focus, int) and 0 <= current_focus < len(focus_options):
            focus_row.set_selected(current_focus)
        else:
            focus_row.set_selected(1)
        focus_row.connect(\"notify::selected\", lambda r, p: self._update_int(\"hyprland.followMouse\", r.get_selected()))
        mouse_grp.add(focus_row)

        sens_val = backend.get(\"hyprland.mouseSensitivity\", 0.0)
        sens_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(sens_val), lower=-1.0, upper=1.0, step_increment=0.1, page_increment=0.2)
        sens_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title=\"Kecepatan Kursor\",
            digits=2,
            adjustment=sens_adj
        ))
        sens_row.connect(\"notify::value\", lambda r, p: self._update_float(\"hyprland.mouseSensitivity\", r.get_value()))
        mouse_grp.add(sens_row)

        touch_grp = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        touch_grp.set_title(\"Touchpad\")
        box.append(touch_grp)

        natural_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Gulir Alami\",
            subtitle=\"Arah gulir mengikuti gerakan jari\"
        )
        natural_row.set_active(backend.get(\"hyprland.touchpadNaturalScroll\", True))
        natural_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: self._update_bool(\"hyprland.touchpadNaturalScroll\", r.get_active()))
        touch_grp.add(natural_row)

        tap_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Ketuk untuk Klik\"
        )
        tap_row.set_active(backend.get(\"hyprland.touchpadTapToClick\", True))
        tap_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: self._update_bool(\"hyprland.touchpadTapToClick\", r.get_active()))
        touch_grp.add(tap_row)

        dwt_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Nonaktifkan Saat Mengetik\",
            subtitle=\"Cegah sentuhan touchpad tidak disengaja saat mengetik\"
        )
        dwt_row.set_active(backend.get(\"hyprland.touchpadDisableWhileTyping\", True))
        dwt_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: self._update_bool(\"hyprland.touchpadDisableWhileTyping\", r.get_active()))
        touch_grp.add(dwt_row)

        return box

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # HELPERS
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_layout_changed(self, row, param):
        val = \"dwindle\" if row.get_selected() == 0 else \"master\"
        backend.set(\"hyprland.layout\", val)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _update_int(self, key, val):
        backend.set(key, int(val))
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _update_float(self, key, val, digits=2):
        backend.set(key, round(float(val), digits))
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _update_bool(self, key, val):
        backend.set(key, bool(val))
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_gaps_in_adv_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_enable_expansion()
        backend.set(\"hyprland.gapsInAdvanced\", is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_gaps_out_adv_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_enable_expansion()
        backend.set(\"hyprland.gapsOutAdvanced\", is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_custom_borders_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_active()
        backend.set(\"hyprland.customBorders\", is_active)
        for r in self.border_color_rows:
            r.set_sensitive(is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _create_color_row(self, title, subtitle, key, default_val):
        row = Adw.ActionRow(title=title)
        if subtitle:
            row.set_subtitle(subtitle)
        color_dialog = Gtk.ColorDialog()
        color_dialog.set_title(title)
        color_dialog.set_with_alpha(True)

        btn = Gtk.ColorDialogButton(dialog=color_dialog)
        btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

        cur_val = backend.get(key, default_val)
        init_rgba = self._parse_hypr_color(cur_val)
        btn.set_rgba(init_rgba)

        def on_color_picked(button, param):
            rgba = button.get_rgba()
            hypr_color = self._rgba_to_hypr_color(rgba)
            backend.set(key, hypr_color)
            backend.apply_hyprland()

        btn.connect(\"notify::rgba\", on_color_picked)
        row.add_suffix(btn)
        return row, btn

    def _on_reset_border_colors(self, button):
        defaults = {
            \"hyprland.activeBorderDark\": \"rgba(33ffdcc6)\",
            \"hyprland.activeBorderLight\": \"rgba(88f700f7)\",
            \"hyprland.inactiveBorderDark\": \"rgba(23191933)\",
            \"hyprland.inactiveBorderLight\": \"rgba(8839ef33)\",
        }
        for k, v in defaults.items():
            backend.set(k, v)

        self.btn_act_dark.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults[\"hyprland.activeBorderDark\"]))
        self.btn_act_light.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults[\"hyprland.activeBorderLight\"]))
        self.btn_inact_dark.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults[\"hyprland.inactiveBorderDark\"]))
        self.btn_inact_light.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults[\"hyprland.inactiveBorderLight\"]))

        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _parse_hypr_color(self, color_str):
        if not color_str:
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=0.5, green=0.5, blue=0.5, alpha=1.0)
        s = str(color_str).strip()
        if s.startswith(\"rgba(\") and s.endswith(\")\"):
            hex_val = s[5:-1]
        elif s.startswith(\"rgb(\") and s.endswith(\")\"):
            hex_val = s[4:-1]
        elif s.startswith(\"#\"):
            hex_val = s[1:]
        elif s.startswith(\"0x\"):
            hex_val = s[2:]
        else:
            hex_val = s

        if len(hex_val) == 8:
            r = int(hex_val[0:2], 16) / 255.0
            g = int(hex_val[2:4], 16) / 255.0
            b = int(hex_val[4:6], 16) / 255.0
            a = int(hex_val[6:8], 16) / 255.0
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=r, green=g, blue=b, alpha=a)
        elif len(hex_val) == 6:
            r = int(hex_val[0:2], 16) / 255.0
            g = int(hex_val[2:4], 16) / 255.0
            b = int(hex_val[4:6], 16) / 255.0
            a = int(hex_val[6:8], 16) / 255.0
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=r, green=g, blue=b, alpha=1.0)
        else:
            c = Gdk.RGBA()
            if c.parse(color_str):
                return c
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=0.2, green=1.0, blue=0.86, alpha=0.78)

    def _rgba_to_hypr_color(self, rgba):
        r = int(round(rgba.red * 255))
        g = int(round(rgba.green * 255))
        b = int(round(rgba.blue * 255))
        a = int(round(rgba.alpha * 255))
        return f\"rgba({r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}{a:02x})\"

    def _on_pos_changed(self, row, param):
        idx = row.get_selected()
        if idx == 0:  # Top
            backend.set("bar.bottom", False)
            backend.set("bar.vertical", False)
        elif idx == 1:  # Left
            backend.set("bar.bottom", False)
            backend.set("bar.vertical", True)
        elif idx == 2:  # Bottom
            backend.set("bar.bottom", True)
            backend.set("bar.vertical", False)
        elif idx == 3:  # Right
            backend.set("bar.bottom", True)
            backend.set("bar.vertical", True)

    def _get_layout(self):
        layout = backend.get("bar.layout")
        if not layout or not isinstance(layout, dict):
            layout = {
                "left": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT["left"]),
                "center": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT["center"]),
                "right": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT["right"]),
            }
        else:
            layout = {
                "left": list(layout.get("left", DEFAULT_LAYOUT["left"])),
                "center": list(layout.get("center", DEFAULT_LAYOUT["center"])),
                "right": list(layout.get("right", DEFAULT_LAYOUT["right"])),
            }
        return layout

    def _save_layout(self, layout):
        backend.set("bar.layout", layout)
        self._refresh_applet_editor_ui()

    def _reset_applet_layout(self):
        layout = {
            "left": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT["left"]),
            "center": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT["center"]),
            "right": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT["right"]),
        }
        self._save_layout(layout)

    def _on_zone_button_toggled(self, zone, button):
        if button.get_active():
            self.current_zone = zone
            self._refresh_applet_editor_ui()

    def _switch_to_zone(self, zone):
        self.current_zone = zone
        if zone == "left":
            self.btn_zone_left.set_active(True)
        elif zone == "center":
            self.btn_zone_center.set_active(True)
        elif zone == "right":
            self.btn_zone_right.set_active(True)
        self._refresh_applet_editor_ui()

    def _clear_box_children(self, box):
        child = box.get_first_child()
        while child:
            next_child = child.get_next_sibling()
            box.remove(child)
            child = next_child

        layout = self._get_layout()
        items = layout.get(self.current_zone, [])
        new_idx = index + direction
        if 0 <= new_idx < len(items):
            items[index], items[new_idx] = items[new_idx], items[index]
            layout[self.current_zone] = items
            self._save_layout(layout)

    def _transfer_applet(self, aid, target_zone, popover):
        popover.popdown()
        layout = self._get_layout()
        if aid in layout.get(self.current_zone, []):
            layout[self.current_zone].remove(aid)
        if aid not in layout.get(target_zone, []):
            layout[target_zone].append(aid)
        self._save_layout(layout)

    def _remove_applet(self, aid):
        layout = self._get_layout()
        if aid in layout.get(self.current_zone, []):
            layout[self.current_zone].remove(aid)
            self._save_layout(layout)

    def _add_applet(self, aid, popover):
        popover.popdown()
        layout = self._get_layout()
        if aid not in layout.get(self.current_zone, []):
            layout[self.current_zone].append(aid)
            self._save_layout(layout)

        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()

        group.set_description("Kustomisasi tingkat opasitas dan kekuatan efek kaca buram pada bilah panel")
        self.append(group)

        # 1. Slider Opasitas Panel (0 - 100%) dengan input angka interaktif
        cur_opacity = backend.get("bar.opacity", 100)
        opacity_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(
            value=float(cur_opacity),
            lower=0.0,
            upper=100.0,
            step_increment=1.0,
            page_increment=10.0
        )
        self.opacity_slider = NumericSlider(
            adjustment=opacity_adj,
            suffix="%",
            min_width=180
        )
        self.opacity_scale = self.opacity_slider.scale

        opacity_row = Adw.ActionRow(
            title="Tingkat Opasitas Panel",
            subtitle="Tingkat kepekatan latar panel (0% = bening total, 100% = pekat)"
        )
        opacity_row.add_suffix(self.opacity_slider)
        self.opacity_slider.connect("value-changed", self._on_opacity_changed)
        group.add(opacity_row)

        # 2. Slider Kekuatan Blur (0 - 100%) dengan input angka interaktif
        cur_blur_strength = backend.get("bar.blurStrength", 40)
        if not backend.get("bar.blur", True):
            cur_blur_strength = 0
        blur_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(
            value=float(cur_blur_strength),
            lower=0.0,
            upper=100.0,
            step_increment=1.0,
            page_increment=10.0
        )
        self.blur_slider = NumericSlider(
            adjustment=blur_adj,
            suffix="%",
            zero_label="Mati",
            min_width=180
        )
        self.blur_scale = self.blur_slider.scale

        blur_row = Adw.ActionRow(
            title="Tingkat Efek Buram (Blur)",
            subtitle="Kekuatan efek kaca buram di balik bilah panel (0% = nonaktif, 100% = paling tinggi)"
        )
        blur_row.add_suffix(self.blur_slider)
        self.blur_slider.connect("value-changed", self._on_blur_changed)
        group.add(blur_row)

    def _on_opacity_changed(self, scale):
        val = int(scale.get_value())
        backend.set("bar.opacity", val)

    def _on_blur_changed(self, scale):
        val = int(scale.get_value())
        is_enabled = (val > 0)
        backend.set("bar.blur", is_enabled)
        backend.set("bar.blurStrength", val)
        if is_enabled:
            size = max(1, min(20, round(val / 100.0 * 20)))
            passes = max(1, min(4, round(1 + val / 100.0 * 3)))
            backend.set("hyprland.blurSize", size)
            backend.set("hyprland.blurPasses", passes)
            backend.set("hyprland.blurEnabled", True)
            try:
                subprocess.Popen([
                    "hyprctl", "eval",
                    f"hl.layer_rule({{ match = {{ namespace = 'quickshell:bar' }}, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.0 }}); "
                    f"hl.layer_rule({{ match = {{ namespace = 'quickshell:celestialBezel' }}, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.5 }}); "
                    f"hl.layer_rule({{ match = {{ namespace = 'quickshell:sidebarRight' }}, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.0 }}); "
                    f"hl.config({{ decoration = {{ blur = {{ enabled = true, size = {size}, passes = {passes} }} }} }})"
                ], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            except Exception:
                pass
        else:
            try:
                subprocess.Popen([
                    "hyprctl", "eval",
                    "hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'quickshell:bar' }, blur = false }); "
                    "hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'quickshell:celestialBezel' }, blur = false }); "
                    "hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'quickshell:sidebarRight' }, blur = false })"
                ], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            except Exception:
                pass
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _refresh_applet_editor_ui(self):
        layout = self._get_layout()

        # Update Zone Button Labels
        self.btn_zone_left.set_label(f"Sisi Kiri ({len(layout['left'])})")
        self.btn_zone_center.set_label(f"Sisi Tengah ({len(layout['center'])})")
        self.btn_zone_right.set_label(f"Sisi Kanan ({len(layout['right'])})")

        # 1. Update Preview Bar Chips
        self._clear_box_children(self.preview_left_box)
        self._clear_box_children(self.preview_center_box)
        self._clear_box_children(self.preview_right_box)

        for zone, box in [("left", self.preview_left_box), ("center", self.preview_center_box), ("right", self.preview_right_box)]:
            for aid in layout[zone]:
                meta = AVAILABLE_APPLETS.get(aid, {"chip": aid, "title": aid})
                btn = Gtk.Button(label=meta["chip"])
                btn.add_css_class("panel-preview-chip")
                btn.set_tooltip_text(f"{meta['title']} ({'Kiri' if zone=='left' else ('Tengah' if zone=='center' else 'Kanan')})")
                if zone == self.current_zone:
                    btn.add_css_class("active-zone")
                z_target = zone
                btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, z=z_target: self._switch_to_zone(z))
                box.append(btn)

        # 2. Update Active Applets List
        for r in self.applet_rows:
            self.applets_list_group.remove(r)
        self.applet_rows.clear()

        zone_names = {"left": "Sisi Kiri", "center": "Sisi Tengah", "right": "Sisi Kanan"}
        self.applets_list_group.set_title(f"Daftar Applet ({zone_names.get(self.current_zone, '')})")
        self.applets_list_group.set_description(f"Kelola urutan dan konfigurasi applet pada {zone_names.get(self.current_zone, '')}")

        active_applets = layout.get(self.current_zone, [])
        if not active_applets:
            empty_row = Adw.ActionRow(
                title="Tidak ada applet pada zona ini",
                subtitle="Klik tombol '+ Tambah Applet Baru' di bawah untuk menyematkan modul."
            )
            empty_row.set_icon_name("dialog-information-symbolic")
            self.applets_list_group.add(empty_row)
            self.applet_rows.append(empty_row)
        else:
            for idx, aid in enumerate(active_applets):
                meta = AVAILABLE_APPLETS.get(aid, {
                    "title": aid,
                    "subtitle": "",
                    "icon": "application-x-executable-symbolic"
                })
                row = Adw.ActionRow(
                    title=meta["title"],
                    subtitle=meta["subtitle"]
                )
                row.set_icon_name(meta["icon"])

                # Move Up / Left
                up_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("go-up-symbolic")
                up_btn.set_tooltip_text("Geser Naik (Maju satu posisi)")
                up_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                up_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                up_btn.set_sensitive(idx > 0)
                cur_idx = idx
                up_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, i=cur_idx: self._move_applet(i, -1))

                # Move Down / Right
                down_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("go-down-symbolic")
                down_btn.set_tooltip_text("Geser Turun (Mundur satu posisi)")
                down_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                down_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                down_btn.set_sensitive(idx < len(active_applets) - 1)
                down_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, i=cur_idx: self._move_applet(i, 1))

                # Move Zone Menu
                move_menu_btn = Gtk.MenuButton()
                move_menu_btn.set_icon_name("view-paged-symbolic")
                move_menu_btn.set_tooltip_text("Pindahkan ke Zona Lain...")
                move_menu_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                move_menu_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

                popover = Gtk.Popover()
                pop_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=4)
                pop_box.set_margin_start(6)
                pop_box.set_margin_end(6)
                pop_box.set_margin_top(6)
                pop_box.set_margin_bottom(6)

                other_zones = [z for z in ["left", "center", "right"] if z != self.current_zone]
                for target_z in other_zones:
                    t_btn = Gtk.Button(label=f"Pindah ke {zone_names.get(target_z, target_z)}")
                    t_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                    t_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, a=aid, tz=target_z, p=popover: self._transfer_applet(a, tz, p))
                    pop_box.append(t_btn)

                popover.set_child(pop_box)
                move_menu_btn.set_popover(popover)

                # Delete Button
                del_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("user-trash-symbolic")
                del_btn.set_tooltip_text("Hapus / Sembunyikan dari Panel")
                del_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                del_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                del_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, a=aid: self._remove_applet(a))

                action_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=2)
                action_box.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                action_box.append(up_btn)
                action_box.append(down_btn)
                action_box.append(move_menu_btn)
                action_box.append(del_btn)
                row.add_suffix(action_box)

                self.applets_list_group.add(row)
                self.applet_rows.append(row)

        # 3. Update Add Applet Popover
        add_popover = Gtk.Popover()
        add_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=4)
        add_box.set_margin_start(8)
        add_box.set_margin_end(8)
        add_box.set_margin_top(8)
        add_box.set_margin_bottom(8)

        # List all available applets not currently in this zone
        available_to_add = [k for k in AVAILABLE_APPLETS if k not in active_applets]
        if not available_to_add:
            lbl = Gtk.Label(label="Semua applet yang tersedia telah aktif di zona ini.")
            lbl.add_css_class("dim-label")
            lbl.set_margin_top(8)
            lbl.set_margin_bottom(8)
            add_box.append(lbl)
        else:
            for k in available_to_add:
                meta = AVAILABLE_APPLETS[k]
                item_btn = Gtk.Button()
                item_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                b_content = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8)
                b_icon = Gtk.Image.new_from_icon_name(meta["icon"])
                b_label = Gtk.Label(label=meta["title"])
                b_content.append(b_icon)
                b_content.append(b_label)
                item_btn.set_child(b_content)
                item_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, a=k, p=add_popover: self._add_applet(a, p))
                add_box.append(item_btn)

        add_popover.set_child(add_box)
        self.add_applet_menu_btn.set_popover(add_popover)

    def _move_applet(self, index, direction):
        layout = self._get_layout()

content = '''import subprocess
import gi
gi.require_version(\"Gtk\", \"4.0\")
gi.require_version(\"Adw\", \"1\")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend
from widgets import NumericSlider, NumericSliderRow, enhance_spin_row

AVAILABLE_APPLETS = {
    \"workspaces\": {
        \"title\": \"Ruang Kerja\",

    },

        \"icon\": \"utilities-system-monitor-symbolic\",

    },
    \"battery\": {
        \"title\": \"Indikator Baterai\",
        \"subtitle\": \"Persentase dan status pengisian daya\",
        \"icon\": \"battery-full-symbolic\",
        \"chip\": \"Baterai\",
    },
    \"weather\": {
        \"title\": \"Cuaca\",
        \"subtitle\": \"Prakiraan cuaca dan suhu lokal\",
        \"icon\": \"weather-clear-symbolic\",
        \"chip\": \"Cuaca\",
    },
    \"systray\": {
        \"title\": \"Baki Sistem\",
        \"subtitle\": \"Ikon aplikasi latar belakang\",
        \"icon\": \"applications-system-symbolic\",
        \"chip\": \"Baki\",
    },
    \"tiling\": {
        \"title\": \"Menu Tiling\",
        \"subtitle\": \"Menu mode ubin jendela Pop Shell\",
        \"icon\": \"view-split-left-symbolic\",
        \"chip\": \"Tiling\",
    },
    \"quicksettings\": {
        \"title\": \"Pengaturan Cepat\",
        \"subtitle\": \"Status Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, dan Audio\",
        \"icon\": \"network-wireless-symbolic\",
        \"chip\": \"Kontrol\",
    },
}

DEFAULT_LAYOUT = {
    \"left\": [\"workspaces\", \"media\"],
    \"center\": [\"clock\"],
    \"right\": [\"systray\", \"zoom\", \"resources\", \"battery\", \"quicksettings\"]
}

class BarPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_position_group()
        self._build_applet_editor_group()
        self._build_workspaces_group()
        self._build_time_group()
        self._build_effects_group()
        self._build_utils_group()

    def _build_position_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Tata Letak\")
        self.append(group)

        pos_options = [
            \"Atas\",
            \"Kiri\",
            \"Bawah\",
            \"Kanan\"
        ]
        pos_model = Gtk.StringList.new(pos_options)
        self.pos_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title=\"Posisi Panel\",
            model=pos_model
        )
        is_bottom = backend.get(\"bar.bottom\", False)
        is_vert = backend.get(\"bar.vertical\", False)
        if not is_bottom and not is_vert:
            cur_idx = 0
        elif not is_bottom and is_vert:
            cur_idx = 1
        elif is_bottom and not is_vert:
            cur_idx = 2
        else:
            cur_idx = 3
        self.pos_row.set_selected(cur_idx)
        self.pos_row.connect(\"notify::selected\", self._on_pos_changed)
        group.add(self.pos_row)

        autohide_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Sembunyikan Otomatis\",
            subtitle=\"Muncul saat kursor menyentuh tepi layar\"
        )
        autohide_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.autoHide.enable\", False))
        autohide_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.autoHide.enable\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(autohide_row)

        corner_options = [
            \"Menempel\",
            \"Melayang\",
            \"Persegi\",
            \"Bezel Layar\"
        ]
        corner_model = Gtk.StringList.new(corner_options)
        corner_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title=\"Bentuk Sudut\",
            model=corner_model
        )
        cur_corner = backend.get(\"bar.cornerStyle\", 0)
        corner_row.set_selected(cur_corner if cur_corner in [0, 1, 2, 3] else 0)
        group.add(corner_row)

        cur_rounding = backend.get(\"bar.rounding\", 24)
        rounding_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(
            value=float(cur_rounding),
            lower=10.0,
            upper=45.0,
            step_increment=1.0,
            page_increment=5.0
        )
        self.rounding_slider = NumericSlider(
            adjustment=rounding_adj,
            suffix=\" px\",
            min_width=180
        )
        self.rounding_row = Adw.ActionRow(
            title=\"Radius Sudut\"
        )
        self.rounding_row.add_suffix(self.rounding_slider)
        self.rounding_slider.connect(\"value-changed\", lambda s: backend.set(\"bar.rounding\", int(s.get_value())))
        group.add(self.rounding_row)

        cur_bezel_thickness = backend.get(\"bar.celestialBezel.thickness\", 3)
        bezel_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(
            value=float(cur_bezel_thickness),
            lower=1.0,
            upper=10.0,
            step_increment=1.0,
            page_increment=1.0
        )
        self.bezel_slider = NumericSlider(
            adjustment=bezel_adj,
            suffix=\" px\",
            min_width=180
        )
        self.bezel_row = Adw.ActionRow(
            title=\"Ketebalan Bezel Layar\"
        )
        self.bezel_row.add_suffix(self.bezel_slider)
        self.bezel_slider.connect(\"value-changed\", lambda s: backend.set(\"bar.celestialBezel.thickness\", int(s.get_value())))
        group.add(self.bezel_row)

        def _update_corner_suboptions(sel_idx):
            self.rounding_row.set_visible(sel_idx in [0, 3])
            self.bezel_row.set_visible(sel_idx == 3)

        _update_corner_suboptions(corner_row.get_selected())
        corner_row.connect(\"notify::selected\", lambda r, p: (
            backend.set(\"bar.cornerStyle\", r.get_selected()),
            _update_corner_suboptions(r.get_selected())
        ))

        cur_panel_scale = backend.get_panel_scale()
        scale_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(
            value=float(cur_panel_scale),
            lower=0.5,
            upper=2.0,
            step_increment=0.1,
            page_increment=0.1
        )
        self.scale_slider = NumericSlider(
            adjustment=scale_adj,
            digits=1,
            suffix=\"x\",
            min_width=180
        )
        self.scale_row = Adw.ActionRow(
            title=\"Skala Panel\"
        )
        self.scale_row.add_suffix(self.scale_slider)
        self.scale_slider.connect(\"value-changed\", lambda s: backend.set_panel_scale(s.get_value()))
        group.add(self.scale_row)

        group_options = [
            \"Kapsul Terpisah\",
            \"Tanpa Garis Tepi\"
        ]
        group_model = Gtk.StringList.new(group_options)
        group_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title=\"Pemisah Modul\",
            model=group_model
        )
        is_borderless = backend.get(\"bar.borderless\", False)
        group_row.set_selected(1 if is_borderless else 0)
        group_row.connect(\"notify::selected\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.borderless\", r.get_selected() == 1))
        group.add(group_row)

        bg_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Latar Belakang Panel\"
        )
        bg_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.showBackground\", True))
        bg_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.showBackground\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(bg_row)

        theme_options = [
            \"Selalu Gelap\",
            \"Ikuti Sistem\",
            \"Selalu Terang\"
        ]
        theme_keys = [\"dark\", \"system\", \"light\"]
        theme_model = Gtk.StringList.new(theme_options)
        theme_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title=\"Tema Warna Panel\",
            model=theme_model
        )
        cur_theme = backend.get(\"bar.themeMode\", \"dark\")
        cur_theme_idx = theme_keys.index(cur_theme) if cur_theme in theme_keys else 0
        theme_row.set_selected(cur_theme_idx)
        theme_row.connect(\"notify::selected\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.themeMode\", theme_keys[r.get_selected()]))
        group.add(theme_row)

    def _on_pos_changed(self, row, param):
        idx = row.get_selected()
        if idx == 0:  # Top
            backend.set(\"bar.bottom\", False)
            backend.set(\"bar.vertical\", False)
        elif idx == 1:  # Left
            backend.set(\"bar.bottom\", False)
            backend.set(\"bar.vertical\", True)
        elif idx == 2:  # Bottom
            backend.set(\"bar.bottom\", True)
            backend.set(\"bar.vertical\", False)
        elif idx == 3:  # Right
            backend.set(\"bar.bottom\", True)
            backend.set(\"bar.vertical\", True)

    # =========================================================================
    # APPLET EDITOR
    # =========================================================================
    def _build_applet_editor_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Susunan Applet\")
        self.append(group)

        preview_container = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=8)
        preview_container.add_css_class(\"card\")
        preview_container.set_margin_bottom(12)
        preview_container.set_margin_top(4)

        preview_header = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8)
        preview_header.set_margin_start(14)
        preview_header.set_margin_end(14)
        preview_header.set_margin_top(10)

        preview_title = Gtk.Label(label=\"Pratinjau Panel\")
        preview_title.add_css_class(\"heading\")
        preview_title.set_hexpand(True)
        preview_title.set_xalign(0)
        preview_header.append(preview_title)

        reset_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name(\"view-refresh-symbolic\")
        reset_btn.set_tooltip_text(\"Reset ke Susunan Bawaan\")
        reset_btn.add_css_class(\"flat\")
        reset_btn.connect(\"clicked\", lambda b: self._reset_applet_layout())
        preview_header.append(reset_btn)

        preview_container.append(preview_header)

        scrolled_preview = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
        scrolled_preview.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC, Gtk.PolicyType.NEVER)
        scrolled_preview.set_min_content_height(42)
        scrolled_preview.set_margin_start(12)
        scrolled_preview.set_margin_end(12)
        scrolled_preview.set_margin_bottom(12)

        self.preview_bar = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)
        self.preview_bar.add_css_class(\"panel-preview-bar\")
        self.preview_bar.set_hexpand(True)

        self.preview_left_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=4)
        self.preview_center_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=4)
        self.preview_right_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=4)

        left_spacer = Gtk.Box()
        left_spacer.set_hexpand(True)

        right_spacer = Gtk.Box()
        right_spacer.set_hexpand(True)

        self.preview_bar.append(self.preview_left_box)
        self.preview_bar.append(left_spacer)
        self.preview_bar.append(self.preview_center_box)
        self.preview_bar.append(right_spacer)
        self.preview_bar.append(self.preview_right_box)

        scrolled_preview.set_child(self.preview_bar)
        preview_container.append(scrolled_preview)
        group.add(preview_container)

        self.current_zone = \"left\"
        self.applet_rows = []

        zone_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=0)
        zone_box.add_css_class(\"linked\")
        zone_box.set_halign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        zone_box.set_margin_bottom(12)

        self.btn_zone_left = Gtk.ToggleButton(label=\"Kiri\")
        self.btn_zone_center = Gtk.ToggleButton(label=\"Tengah\")
        self.btn_zone_right = Gtk.ToggleButton(label=\"Kanan\")

        self.btn_zone_center.set_group(self.btn_zone_left)
        self.btn_zone_right.set_group(self.btn_zone_left)
        self.btn_zone_left.set_active(True)

        self.btn_zone_left.connect(\"toggled\", lambda b: self._on_zone_button_toggled(\"left\", b))
        self.btn_zone_center.connect(\"toggled\", lambda b: self._on_zone_button_toggled(\"center\", b))
        self.btn_zone_right.connect(\"toggled\", lambda b: self._on_zone_button_toggled(\"right\", b))

        zone_box.append(self.btn_zone_left)
        zone_box.append(self.btn_zone_center)
        zone_box.append(self.btn_zone_right)

        group.add(zone_box)

        self.applets_list_group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        self.append(self.applets_list_group)

        self.add_applet_row = Adw.ActionRow(
            title=\"Tambah Applet\"
        )
        self.add_applet_menu_btn = Gtk.MenuButton()
        self.add_applet_menu_btn.set_icon_name(\"list-add-symbolic\")
        self.add_applet_menu_btn.add_css_class(\"suggested-action\")
        self.add_applet_row.add_suffix(self.add_applet_menu_btn)
        self.append(self.add_applet_row)

        self._refresh_applet_editor_ui()

    def _get_layout(self):
        layout = backend.get(\"bar.layout\")
        if not layout or not isinstance(layout, dict):
            layout = {
                \"left\": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT[\"left\"]),
                \"center\": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT[\"center\"]),
                \"right\": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT[\"right\"]),
            }
        else:
            layout = {
                \"left\": list(layout.get(\"left\", DEFAULT_LAYOUT[\"left\"])),
                \"center\": list(layout.get(\"center\", DEFAULT_LAYOUT[\"center\"])),
                \"right\": list(layout.get(\"right\", DEFAULT_LAYOUT[\"right\"])),
            }
        return layout

    def _save_layout(self, layout):
        backend.set(\"bar.layout\", layout)
        self._refresh_applet_editor_ui()

    def _reset_applet_layout(self):
        layout = {
            \"left\": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT[\"left\"]),
            \"center\": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT[\"center\"]),
            \"right\": list(DEFAULT_LAYOUT[\"right\"]),
        }
        self._save_layout(layout)

    def _on_zone_button_toggled(self, zone, button):
        if button.get_active():
            self.current_zone = zone
            self._refresh_applet_editor_ui()

    def _switch_to_zone(self, zone):
        self.current_zone = zone
        if zone == \"left\":
            self.btn_zone_left.set_active(True)
        elif zone == \"center\":
            self.btn_zone_center.set_active(True)
        elif zone == \"right\":
            self.btn_zone_right.set_active(True)
        self._refresh_applet_editor_ui()

    def _clear_box_children(self, box):
        child = box.get_first_child()
        while child:
            next_child = child.get_next_sibling()
            box.remove(child)
            child = next_child

    def _refresh_applet_editor_ui(self):
        layout = self._get_layout()

        self.btn_zone_left.set_label(f\"Kiri ({len(layout['left'])})\")
        self.btn_zone_center.set_label(f\"Tengah ({len(layout['center'])})\")
        self.btn_zone_right.set_label(f\"Kanan ({len(layout['right'])})\")

        self._clear_box_children(self.preview_left_box)
        self._clear_box_children(self.preview_center_box)
        self._clear_box_children(self.preview_right_box)

        for zone, box in [(\"left\", self.preview_left_box), (\"center\", self.preview_center_box), (\"right\", self.preview_right_box)]:
            for aid in layout[zone]:
                meta = AVAILABLE_APPLETS.get(aid, {\"chip\": aid, \"title\": aid})
                btn = Gtk.Button(label=meta[\"chip\"])
                btn.add_css_class(\"panel-preview-chip\")
                btn.set_tooltip_text(f\"{meta['title']} ({'Kiri' if zone=='left' else ('Tengah' if zone=='center' else 'Kanan')})\")
                if zone == self.current_zone:
                    btn.add_css_class(\"active-zone\")
                z_target = zone
                btn.connect(\"clicked\", lambda b, z=z_target: self._switch_to_zone(z))
                box.append(btn)

        for r in self.applet_rows:
            self.applets_list_group.remove(r)
        self.applet_rows.clear()

        zone_names = {\"left\": \"Sisi Kiri\", \"center\": \"Sisi Tengah\", \"right\": \"Sisi Kanan\"}
        self.applets_list_group.set_title(f\"Daftar Applet ({zone_names.get(self.current_zone, '')})\")

        active_applets = layout.get(self.current_zone, [])
        if not active_applets:
            empty_row = Adw.ActionRow(
                title=\"Tidak ada applet pada zona ini\",
                subtitle=\"Gunakan tombol '+ Tambah Applet' untuk menambahkan modul.\"
            )
            empty_row.set_icon_name(\"dialog-information-symbolic\")
            self.applets_list_group.add(empty_row)
            self.applet_rows.append(empty_row)
        else:
            for idx, aid in enumerate(active_applets):
                meta = AVAILABLE_APPLETS.get(aid, {
                    \"title\": aid,
                    \"subtitle\": \"\",
                    \"icon\": \"application-x-executable-symbolic\"
                })
                row = Adw.ActionRow(
                    title=meta[\"title\"],
                    subtitle=meta[\"subtitle\"]
                )
                row.set_icon_name(meta[\"icon\"])

                up_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name(\"go-up-symbolic\")
                up_btn.set_tooltip_text(\"Geser Naik\")
                up_btn.add_css_class(\"flat\")
                up_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                up_btn.set_sensitive(idx > 0)
                cur_idx = idx
                up_btn.connect(\"clicked\", lambda b, i=cur_idx: self._move_applet(i, -1))

                down_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name(\"go-down-symbolic\")
                down_btn.set_tooltip_text(\"Geser Turun\")
                down_btn.add_css_class(\"flat\")
                down_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                down_btn.set_sensitive(idx < len(active_applets) - 1)
                down_btn.connect(\"clicked\", lambda b, i=cur_idx: self._move_applet(i, 1))

                move_menu_btn = Gtk.MenuButton()
                move_menu_btn.set_icon_name(\"view-paged-symbolic\")
                move_menu_btn.set_tooltip_text(\"Pindahkan ke Zona Lain...\")
                move_menu_btn.add_css_class(\"flat\")
                move_menu_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

                popover = Gtk.Popover()
                pop_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=4)
                pop_box.set_margin_start(6)
                pop_box.set_margin_end(6)
                pop_box.set_margin_top(6)
                pop_box.set_margin_bottom(6)

                other_zones = [z for z in [\"left\", \"center\", \"right\"] if z != self.current_zone]
                for target_z in other_zones:
                    t_btn = Gtk.Button(label=f\"Pindah ke {zone_names.get(target_z, target_z)}\")
                    t_btn.add_css_class(\"flat\")
                    t_btn.connect(\"clicked\", lambda b, a=aid, tz=target_z, p=popover: self._transfer_applet(a, tz, p))
                    pop_box.append(t_btn)

                popover.set_child(pop_box)
                move_menu_btn.set_popover(popover)

                del_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name(\"user-trash-symbolic\")
                del_btn.set_tooltip_text(\"Hapus dari Panel\")
                del_btn.add_css_class(\"flat\")
                del_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                del_btn.connect(\"clicked\", lambda b, a=aid: self._remove_applet(a))

                action_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=2)
                action_box.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                action_box.append(up_btn)
                action_box.append(down_btn)
                action_box.append(move_menu_btn)
                action_box.append(del_btn)
                row.add_suffix(action_box)

                self.applets_list_group.add(row)
                self.applet_rows.append(row)

        add_popover = Gtk.Popover()
        add_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=4)
        add_box.set_margin_start(8)
        add_box.set_margin_end(8)
        add_box.set_margin_top(8)
        add_box.set_margin_bottom(8)

        available_to_add = [k for k in AVAILABLE_APPLETS if k not in active_applets]
        if not available_to_add:
            lbl = Gtk.Label(label=\"Semua applet telah aktif di zona ini.\")
            lbl.add_css_class(\"dim-label\")
            lbl.set_margin_top(8)
            lbl.set_margin_bottom(8)
            add_box.append(lbl)
        else:
            for k in available_to_add:
                meta = AVAILABLE_APPLETS[k]
                item_btn = Gtk.Button()
                item_btn.add_css_class(\"flat\")
                b_content = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8)
                b_icon = Gtk.Image.new_from_icon_name(meta[\"icon\"])
                b_label = Gtk.Label(label=meta[\"title\"])
                b_content.append(b_icon)
                b_content.append(b_label)
                item_btn.set_child(b_content)
                item_btn.connect(\"clicked\", lambda b, a=k, p=add_popover: self._add_applet(a, p))
                add_box.append(item_btn)

        add_popover.set_child(add_box)
        self.add_applet_menu_btn.set_popover(add_popover)

    def _move_applet(self, index, direction):
        layout = self._get_layout()
        items = layout.get(self.current_zone, [])
        new_idx = index + direction
        if 0 <= new_idx < len(items):
            items[index], items[new_idx] = items[new_idx], items[index]
            layout[self.current_zone] = items
            self._save_layout(layout)

    def _transfer_applet(self, aid, target_zone, popover):
        popover.popdown()
        layout = self._get_layout()
        if aid in layout.get(self.current_zone, []):
            layout[self.current_zone].remove(aid)
        if aid not in layout.get(target_zone, []):
            layout[target_zone].append(aid)
        self._save_layout(layout)

    def _remove_applet(self, aid):
        layout = self._get_layout()
        if aid in layout.get(self.current_zone, []):
            layout[self.current_zone].remove(aid)
            self._save_layout(layout)

    def _add_applet(self, aid, popover):
        popover.popdown()
        layout = self._get_layout()
        if aid not in layout.get(self.current_zone, []):
            layout[self.current_zone].append(aid)
            self._save_layout(layout)

    # =========================================================================
    # EFFECTS, TIME, WORKSPACES, UTILS
    # =========================================================================
    def _build_effects_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Efek Visual\")
        self.append(group)

        cur_opacity = backend.get(\"bar.opacity\", 100)
        opacity_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(
            value=float(cur_opacity),
            lower=0.0,
            upper=100.0,
            step_increment=1.0,
            page_increment=10.0
        )
        self.opacity_slider = NumericSlider(
            adjustment=opacity_adj,
            suffix=\"%\",
            min_width=180
        )
        self.opacity_scale = self.opacity_slider.scale

        opacity_row = Adw.ActionRow(
            title=\"Opasitas Panel\"
        )
        opacity_row.add_suffix(self.opacity_slider)
        self.opacity_slider.connect(\"value-changed\", self._on_opacity_changed)
        group.add(opacity_row)

        cur_blur_strength = backend.get(\"bar.blurStrength\", 40)
        if not backend.get(\"bar.blur\", True):
            cur_blur_strength = 0
        blur_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(
            value=float(cur_blur_strength),
            lower=0.0,
            upper=100.0,
            step_increment=1.0,
            page_increment=10.0
        )
        self.blur_slider = NumericSlider(
            adjustment=blur_adj,
            suffix=\"%\",
            zero_label=\"Mati\",
            min_width=180
        )
        self.blur_scale = self.blur_slider.scale

        blur_row = Adw.ActionRow(
            title=\"Efek Blur\"
        )
        blur_row.add_suffix(self.blur_slider)
        self.blur_slider.connect(\"value-changed\", self._on_blur_changed)
        group.add(blur_row)

    def _on_opacity_changed(self, scale):
        val = int(scale.get_value())
        backend.set(\"bar.opacity\", val)

    def _on_blur_changed(self, scale):
        val = int(scale.get_value())
        is_enabled = (val > 0)
        backend.set(\"bar.blur\", is_enabled)
        backend.set(\"bar.blurStrength\", val)
        if is_enabled:
            size = max(1, min(20, round(val / 100.0 * 20)))
            passes = max(1, min(4, round(1 + val / 100.0 * 3)))
            backend.set(\"hyprland.blurSize\", size)
            backend.set(\"hyprland.blurPasses\", passes)
            backend.set(\"hyprland.blurEnabled\", True)
            try:
                subprocess.Popen([
                    \"hyprctl\", \"eval\",
                    f\"hl.layer_rule({{ match = {{ namespace = 'quickshell:bar' }}, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.0 }}); \"
                    f\"hl.layer_rule({{ match = {{ namespace = 'quickshell:celestialBezel' }}, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.5 }}); \"
                    f\"hl.layer_rule({{ match = {{ namespace = 'quickshell:sidebarRight' }}, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.0 }}); \"
                    f\"hl.config({{ decoration = {{ blur = {{ enabled = true, size = {size}, passes = {passes} }} }} }})\"
                ], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            except Exception:
                pass
        else:
            try:
                subprocess.Popen([
                    \"hyprctl\", \"eval\",
                    \"hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'quickshell:bar' }, blur = false }); \"
                    \"hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'quickshell:celestialBezel' }, blur = false }); \"
                    \"hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'quickshell:sidebarRight' }, blur = false })\"
                ], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            except Exception:
                pass
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _build_time_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Waktu & Tanggal\")
        self.append(group)

        time_options = [
            \"24 Jam Sederhana (14:30)\",
            \"Standar GNOME (Sep 4  14:30)\",
            \"Lengkap dengan Hari (Jumat, Sep 4  14:30)\"
        ]
        time_model = Gtk.StringList.new(time_options)
        time_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title=\"Format Jam\",
            model=time_model
        )
        cur_fmt = backend.get(\"gnome.clockFormat\", 1)
        time_row.set_selected(cur_fmt if cur_fmt in [0, 1, 2] else 1)
        time_row.connect(\"notify::selected\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"gnome.clockFormat\", r.get_selected()))
        group.add(time_row)

        sec_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Tampilkan Detik\"
        )
        sec_row.set_active(backend.get(\"time.secondPrecision\", False))
        sec_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"time.secondPrecision\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(sec_row)

    def _build_workspaces_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Ruang Kerja\")
        self.append(group)

        dyn_row = Adw.SwitchRow(

        )
        dyn_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.workspaces.dynamic\", False))
        dyn_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.workspaces.dynamic\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(dyn_row)

        shown_val = backend.get(\"bar.workspaces.shown\", 10)
        shown_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(shown_val), lower=1, upper=10, step_increment=1, page_increment=1)
        shown_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title=\"Jumlah Indikator Ruang Kerja\",
            adjustment=shown_adj
        ))
        shown_row.connect(\"notify::value\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.workspaces.shown\", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(shown_row)

        dot_style_options = [
            \"Cincin Lingkaran\",
            \"Titik Kecil\",
            \"Titik Penuh\"
        ]
        dot_style_model = Gtk.StringList.new(dot_style_options)
        dot_style_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title=\"Gaya Indikator\",
            model=dot_style_model
        )
        cur_dot_style = backend.get(\"bar.workspaces.dotStyle\", \"hollow\")
        if cur_dot_style == \"small\":
            dot_idx = 1
        elif cur_dot_style == \"classic\":
            dot_idx = 2
        else:
            dot_idx = 0
        dot_style_row.set_selected(dot_idx)
        def _on_dot_style_changed(row, param):
            idx = row.get_selected()
            val = \"hollow\" if idx == 0 else (\"small\" if idx == 1 else \"classic\")
            backend.set(\"bar.workspaces.dotStyle\", val)
        dot_style_row.connect(\"notify::selected\", _on_dot_style_changed)
        group.add(dot_style_row)

        app_icons_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Ikon Aplikasi Aktif\"
        )
        app_icons_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.workspaces.showAppIcons\", True))
        app_icons_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.workspaces.showAppIcons\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(app_icons_row)

        mono_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Ikon Monokrom\"
        )
        mono_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.workspaces.monochromeIcons\", True))
        mono_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.workspaces.monochromeIcons\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(mono_row)

    def _build_utils_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()

        tiling_row = Adw.SwitchRow(

        tiling_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.tiling.enable\", True))

        snip_row = Adw.SwitchRow(

        snip_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.utilButtons.showScreenSnip\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(snip_row)

        color_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Pemilih Warna\"
        )
        color_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.utilButtons.showColorPicker\", False))
        color_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.utilButtons.showColorPicker\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(color_row)

        kbd_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Papan Ketik Virtual\"
        )
        kbd_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.utilButtons.showKeyboardToggle\", True))
        kbd_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.utilButtons.showKeyboardToggle\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(kbd_row)

        dark_toggle_row = Adw.SwitchRow(

        dark_toggle_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.utilButtons.showDarkModeToggle\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(dark_toggle_row)

        perf_row = Adw.SwitchRow(

        perf_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.utilButtons.showPerformanceProfileToggle\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(perf_row)

        mic_row = Adw.SwitchRow(

        )
        mic_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.utilButtons.showMicToggle\", False))
        mic_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.utilButtons.showMicToggle\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(mic_row)

        rec_row = Adw.SwitchRow(

        )
        rec_row.set_active(backend.get(\"bar.utilButtons.showScreenRecord\", False))
        rec_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"bar.utilButtons.showScreenRecord\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(rec_row)

    def _on_macos_blur_toggled(self, row, _param):
        is_enabled = row.get_active()
        backend.set("launcher.macos.blur", is_enabled)
        # blurStrength dipertahankan hanya sebagai penanda kompatibilitas
        # (shell versi baru tidak lagi memakainya untuk menghitung opasitas).
        backend.set("launcher.macos.blurStrength", 50 if is_enabled else 0)

    def _build_timeout_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Durasi Kemunculan Pop-up (OSD dan Notifikasi)")
        group.set_description("Waktu tampil indikator volume, kecerahan, dan notifikasi pesan")
        self.append(group)

        # OSD timeout
        osd_val = backend.get("osd.timeout", 1000)
        osd_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(osd_val), lower=500, upper=5000, step_increment=250, page_increment=500)
        osd_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Lama Muncul Kotak Volume dan Kecerahan (ms)",
            subtitle="Berapa milidetik kotak indikator tampil sebelum menghilang otomatis",
            adjustment=osd_adj
        ))
        osd_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("osd.timeout", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(osd_row)

        # Notification timeout
        notif_val = backend.get("notifications.timeout", 7000)
        notif_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(notif_val), lower=1000, upper=15000, step_increment=1000, page_increment=2000)
        notif_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Lama Muncul Balon Notifikasi (ms)",
            subtitle="Berapa milidetik pesan notifikasi baru melayang di sudut layar",
            adjustment=notif_adj
        ))
        notif_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("notifications.timeout", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(notif_row)

content = '''import gi
gi.require_version(\"Gtk\", \"4.0\")
gi.require_version(\"Adw\", \"1\")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend
from widgets import enhance_spin_row

class LockPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_lock_group()

    def _build_lock_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Layar Kunci\")
        self.append(group)

        # Hyprlock vs Quickshell
        backend_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Gunakan Hyprlock\",
            subtitle=\"Layar kunci bawaan yang cepat dan ringan\"
        )
        backend_row.set_active(backend.get(\"lock.useHyprlock\", False))
        backend_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"lock.useHyprlock\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(backend_row)

        # Blur lockscreen
        blur_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Buramkan Latar Belakang\"
        )
        blur_row.set_active(backend.get(\"lock.blur.enable\", True))
        blur_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"lock.blur.enable\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(blur_row)

        # Blur extra zoom
        zoom_val = backend.get(\"lock.blur.extraZoom\", 1.1) * 100
        zoom_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(zoom_val), lower=100, upper=150, step_increment=5, page_increment=10)
        zoom_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title=\"Perbesaran Blur Latar (%)\",
            adjustment=zoom_adj
        ))
        zoom_row.connect(\"notify::value\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"lock.blur.extraZoom\", round(r.get_value() / 100.0, 2)))
        group.add(zoom_row)

        # Center clock
        center_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Jam di Tengah Layar\"
        )
        center_row.set_active(backend.get(\"lock.centerClock\", True))
        center_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"lock.centerClock\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(center_row)

        # Show locked text
        locked_text_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Teks Status Terkunci\"
        )
        locked_text_row.set_active(backend.get(\"lock.showLockedText\", True))
        locked_text_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"lock.showLockedText\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(locked_text_row)

        # Varied shapes for password dots
        shape_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Variasi Bentuk Titik Sandi\"
        )
        shape_row.set_active(backend.get(\"lock.materialShapeChars\", True))
        shape_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"lock.materialShapeChars\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(shape_row)

        # Password to power
        power_pwd_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Wajib Sandi untuk Mematikan\",
            subtitle=\"Minta kata sandi sebelum mematikan dari layar kunci\"
        )
        power_pwd_row.set_active(backend.get(\"lock.security.requirePasswordToPower\", False))
        power_pwd_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"lock.security.requirePasswordToPower\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(power_pwd_row)

        # Unlock keyring
        keyring_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Buka Kunci Keyring Otomatis\",
            subtitle=\"Buka dompet sandi aplikasi saat berhasil masuk\"
        )
        keyring_row.set_active(backend.get(\"lock.security.unlockKeyring\", True))
        keyring_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"lock.security.unlockKeyring\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(keyring_row)

DockLockPage = LockPage
'''
with open('/home/rifqi/.config/hypr/settings-gtk/pages/dock_lock_page.py', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)

content = '''import gi
gi.require_version(\"Gtk\", \"4.0\")
gi.require_version(\"Adw\", \"1\")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend

class SearchSafetyPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_work_safety_group()
        self._build_save_paths_group()

    def _build_work_safety_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Penyaringan Konten\")
        self.append(group)

        # Wallpaper filter
        wall_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Sembunyikan Wallpaper Pribadi di Jaringan Publik\",
            subtitle=\"Otomatis beralih ke latar netral saat di Wi-Fi publik atau kantor\"
        )
        wall_row.set_active(backend.get(\"workSafety.enable.wallpaper\", True))
        wall_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"workSafety.enable.wallpaper\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(wall_row)

        # Clipboard filter
        clip_safe_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Sensor Gambar di Riwayat Papan Klip\",
            subtitle=\"Buramkan pratinjau gambar sensitif pada riwayat clipboard\"
        )
        clip_safe_row.set_active(backend.get(\"workSafety.enable.clipboard\", False))
        clip_safe_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"workSafety.enable.clipboard\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(clip_safe_row)

    def _build_save_paths_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Lokasi Penyimpanan Media\")
        self.append(group)

        rec_row = Adw.EntryRow(title=\"Folder Rekaman Layar\")
        rec_row.set_text(backend.get(\"screenRecord.savePath\", \"~/Videos\"))
        rec_row.set_show_apply_button(True)
        rec_row.connect(\"apply\", lambda r: backend.set(\"screenRecord.savePath\", r.get_text()))
        group.add(rec_row)

        snip_row = Adw.EntryRow(title=\"Folder Tangkapan Layar\")
        snip_path = backend.get(\"screenSnip.savePath\", \"\")
        snip_row.set_text(snip_path)
        snip_row.set_tooltip_text(\"Kosongkan untuk hanya menyalin ke papan klip tanpa menyimpan berkas\")
        snip_row.set_show_apply_button(True)
        snip_row.connect(\"apply\", lambda r: backend.set(\"screenSnip.savePath\", r.get_text()))
        group.add(snip_row)
'''

content = '''import gi
gi.require_version(\"Gtk\", \"4.0\")
gi.require_version(\"Adw\", \"1\")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend

class AudioPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_protection_group()
        self._build_sounds_group()

    def _build_protection_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Proteksi Volume\")
        self.append(group)

        # Enable protection
        prot_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Batas Lonjakan Volume\",
            subtitle=\"Cegah kenaikan volume suara yang melonjak mendadak\"
        )
        prot_row.set_active(backend.get(\"audio.protection.enable\", False))
        prot_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"audio.protection.enable\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(prot_row)

        # Max allowed increase
        inc_val = backend.get(\"audio.protection.maxAllowedIncrease\", 10)
        inc_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(inc_val), lower=1, upper=50, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        inc_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title=\"Maksimal Kenaikan per Langkah (%)\",
            adjustment=inc_adj
        )
        inc_row.connect(\"notify::value\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"audio.protection.maxAllowedIncrease\", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(inc_row)

        # Max allowed absolute
        max_val = backend.get(\"audio.protection.maxAllowed\", 99)
        max_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(max_val), lower=50, upper=153, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        max_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title=\"Batas Volume Maksimal (%)\",
            adjustment=max_adj
        )
        max_row.connect(\"notify::value\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"audio.protection.maxAllowed\", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(max_row)

    def _build_sounds_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Efek Suara\")
        self.append(group)

        # Battery sound
        bat_sound_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Suara Pengisi Daya\",
            subtitle=\"Bunyi saat kabel daya dicolok atau dicabut\"
        )
        bat_sound_row.set_active(backend.get(\"sounds.battery\", True))
        bat_sound_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"sounds.battery\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(bat_sound_row)

        # Pomodoro sound
        pomo_sound_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Suara Pomodoro\",
            subtitle=\"Bunyi saat sesi fokus atau istirahat selesai\"
        )
        pomo_sound_row.set_active(backend.get(\"sounds.pomodoro\", True))
        pomo_sound_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"sounds.pomodoro\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(pomo_sound_row)
'''
with open('/home/rifqi/.config/hypr/settings-gtk/pages/audio_page.py', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)

content = '''import gi
gi.require_version(\"Gtk\", \"4.0\")
gi.require_version(\"Adw\", \"1\")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend
from widgets import enhance_spin_row

class PowerPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_warnings_group()
        self._build_suspend_group()

    def _build_warnings_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Peringatan Baterai\")
        self.append(group)

        # Low warning
        low_val = backend.get(\"battery.low\", 20)
        low_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(low_val), lower=10, upper=40, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        low_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title=\"Baterai Lemah (%)\",
            subtitle=\"Pengingat saat baterai mulai menipis\",
            adjustment=low_adj
        ))
        low_row.connect(\"notify::value\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"battery.low\", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(low_row)

        # Critical warning
        crit_val = backend.get(\"battery.critical\", 5)
        crit_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(crit_val), lower=3, upper=15, step_increment=1, page_increment=2)
        crit_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title=\"Baterai Kritis (%)\",
            subtitle=\"Peringatan mendesak sebelum daya habis\",
            adjustment=crit_adj
        ))
        crit_row.connect(\"notify::value\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"battery.critical\", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(crit_row)

        # Full charge warning (101 = disabled)
        full_val = backend.get(\"battery.full\", 101)
        full_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(full_val), lower=50, upper=101, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        full_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title=\"Baterai Penuh (%)\",
            subtitle=\"Pengingat lepas kabel daya (atur 101 untuk nonaktifkan)\",
            adjustment=full_adj
        ))
        full_row.connect(\"notify::value\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"battery.full\", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(full_row)

    def _build_suspend_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title(\"Hemat Daya\")
        self.append(group)

        # Automatic suspend switch
        auto_suspend_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title=\"Suspensi Otomatis\",
            subtitle=\"Alihkan komputer ke mode tidur saat baterai kritis\"
        )
        auto_suspend_row.set_active(backend.get(\"battery.automaticSuspend\", True))
        auto_suspend_row.connect(\"notify::active\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"battery.automaticSuspend\", r.get_active()))
        group.add(auto_suspend_row)

        # Suspend threshold
        suspend_val = backend.get(\"battery.suspend\", 3)
        suspend_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(suspend_val), lower=1, upper=10, step_increment=1, page_increment=1)
        suspend_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title=\"Ambang Batas Suspensi (%)\",
            adjustment=suspend_adj
        ))
        suspend_row.connect(\"notify::value\", lambda r, p: backend.set(\"battery.suspend\", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(suspend_row)
'''
with open('/home/rifqi/.config/hypr/settings-gtk/pages/power_page.py', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)
