import os
import subprocess
import gi
gi.require_version("Gtk", "4.0")
gi.require_version("Adw", "1")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw, Gio, GdkPixbuf
from backend import backend

def get_thumbnail_paintable(path, width=80, height=50):
    if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    try:
        pb = GdkPixbuf.Pixbuf.new_from_file_at_scale(path, width, height, True)
        if pb:
            from gi.repository import Gdk
            return Gdk.Texture.new_for_pixbuf(pb)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None

class WallpaperPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_wallpapers_group()
        self._build_parallax_group()

    def refresh_page(self):
        cur_wall = backend.get("background.wallpaperPath", "")
        self.current_row.set_subtitle(cur_wall if cur_wall else "Belum aktif")
        self._update_picture(self.cur_pic, cur_wall)

        light_path = backend.get("background.lightWallpaperPath", "")
        self.light_row.set_subtitle(light_path if light_path else "Belum dipilih (Gunakan bawaan)")
        self._update_picture(self.light_pic, light_path)

        dark_path = backend.get("background.darkWallpaperPath", "")
        self.dark_row.set_subtitle(dark_path if dark_path else "Belum dipilih (Gunakan bawaan)")
        self._update_picture(self.dark_pic, dark_path)

    def _update_picture(self, picture_widget, path):
        paintable = get_thumbnail_paintable(path)
        if paintable:
            picture_widget.set_paintable(paintable)
            picture_widget.set_visible(True)
        else:
            picture_widget.set_visible(False)

    def _build_wallpapers_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Status Wallpaper")
        self.append(group)

        # Centralized Management Banner Row
        banner_row = Adw.ActionRow()
        banner_row.set_title("Dikelola oleh Wallpaper Changer")
        banner_row.set_subtitle("Folder koleksi dan rotasi otomatis dikelola di aplikasi Wallpaper Changer")
        banner_row.set_icon_name("preferences-desktop-wallpaper-symbolic")

        btn_open_app = Gtk.Button()
        b_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)
        b_img = Gtk.Image.new_from_icon_name("preferences-desktop-wallpaper-symbolic")
        b_img.set_pixel_size(16)
        b_lbl = Gtk.Label(label="Buka Desktop Wallpaper")
        b_box.append(b_img)
        b_box.append(b_lbl)
        btn_open_app.set_child(b_box)
        btn_open_app.add_css_class("suggested-action")
        btn_open_app.add_css_class("pill")
        btn_open_app.connect("clicked", lambda b: subprocess.Popen(["/home/rifqi/.local/bin/wallpaper-changer"]))
        banner_row.add_suffix(btn_open_app)
        group.add(banner_row)

        # Current Active Wallpaper Row (Read-Only Preview)
        self.current_row = Adw.ActionRow()
        self.current_row.set_title("Wallpaper Aktif")
        cur_wall = backend.get("background.wallpaperPath", "")
        self.current_row.set_subtitle(cur_wall if cur_wall else "Belum aktif")

        self.cur_pic = Gtk.Picture()
        self.cur_pic.set_size_request(80, 50)
        self.cur_pic.set_content_fit(Gtk.ContentFit.COVER)
        self.cur_pic.add_css_class("card")
        self._update_picture(self.cur_pic, cur_wall)
        self.current_row.add_suffix(self.cur_pic)
        group.add(self.current_row)

        # Light Wallpaper Row (Read-Only Preview)
        self.light_row = Adw.ActionRow()
        self.light_row.set_title("Mode Terang")
        light_path = backend.get("background.lightWallpaperPath", "")
        self.light_row.set_subtitle(light_path if light_path else "Belum dipilih (Gunakan bawaan)")

        self.light_pic = Gtk.Picture()
        self.light_pic.set_size_request(80, 50)
        self.light_pic.set_content_fit(Gtk.ContentFit.COVER)
        self.light_pic.add_css_class("card")
        self._update_picture(self.light_pic, light_path)
        self.light_row.add_suffix(self.light_pic)
        group.add(self.light_row)

        # Dark Wallpaper Row (Read-Only Preview)
        self.dark_row = Adw.ActionRow()
        self.dark_row.set_title("Mode Gelap")
        dark_path = backend.get("background.darkWallpaperPath", "")
        self.dark_row.set_subtitle(dark_path if dark_path else "Belum dipilih (Gunakan bawaan)")

        self.dark_pic = Gtk.Picture()
        self.dark_pic.set_size_request(80, 50)
        self.dark_pic.set_content_fit(Gtk.ContentFit.COVER)
        self.dark_pic.add_css_class("card")
        self._update_picture(self.dark_pic, dark_path)
        self.dark_row.add_suffix(self.dark_pic)
        group.add(self.dark_row)

        # Fullscreen behavior
        fs_row = Adw.SwitchRow()
        fs_row.set_title("Sembunyikan Wallpaper saat Layar Penuh")
        fs_row.set_subtitle("Hemat daya GPU saat jendela layar penuh aktif")
        fs_row.set_active(backend.get("background.hideWhenFullscreen", True))
        fs_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("background.hideWhenFullscreen", r.get_active()))
        group.add(fs_row)

    def _build_parallax_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Efek Parallax")
        self.append(group)

        # Enable workspace parallax
        ws_row = Adw.SwitchRow()
        ws_row.set_title("Parallax Ruang Kerja")
        ws_row.set_subtitle("Gambar latar bergeser saat berpindah ruang kerja")
        ws_row.set_active(backend.get("background.parallax.enableWorkspace", False))
        ws_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("background.parallax.enableWorkspace", r.get_active()))
        group.add(ws_row)

        # Enable sidebar parallax
        sb_row = Adw.SwitchRow()
        sb_row.set_title("Parallax Bilah Samping")
        sb_row.set_subtitle("Gambar latar bergeser saat panel samping dibuka")
        sb_row.set_active(backend.get("background.parallax.enableSidebar", False))
        sb_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("background.parallax.enableSidebar", r.get_active()))
        group.add(sb_row)

        # Zoom level
        zoom_val = int(backend.get("background.parallax.workspaceZoom", 1.07) * 100)
        zoom_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(zoom_val), lower=100, upper=200, step_increment=2, page_increment=10)
        zoom_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Skala Perbesaran Parallax (%)",
            adjustment=zoom_adj
        )
        zoom_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("background.parallax.workspaceZoom", round(r.get_value() / 100.0, 2)))
        group.add(zoom_row)

**Tool Call: python3 -c "
import os, re

pages_dir = '/home/rifqi/.config/hypr/settings-gtk/pages'
for f in sorted(os.listdir(pages_dir)):
    if not f.endswith('.py') or f == '__init__.py': continue
    path = os.path.join(pages_dir, f)
    with open(path) as fp:
        content = fp.read()
    gets = set(re.findall(r'backend\.get\([\"\']([^\"\']+)[\"\']', content))
    sets = set(re.findall(r'backend\.set\([\"\']([^\"\']+)[\"\']', content))
    calls = set(re.findall(r'backend\.([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\(', content)) - {'get', 'set'}
    print(f'=== {f} ===')
    print('  backend.get:', sorted(gets))
    print('  backend.set:', sorted(sets))
    print('  backend calls:', sorted(calls))

class GeneralPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)

        # View Stack & Switcher

        self.stack.set_vexpand(True)

        switcher = Adw.ViewSwitcher()
        switcher.set_stack(self.stack)
        switcher.set_policy(Adw.ViewSwitcherPolicy.WIDE)
        switcher.set_halign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

        self.append(switcher)

        # 1. Tata Letak
        self.stack.add_titled_with_icon(self._build_tiling_page(), "tiling", "Tata Letak", "view-grid-symbolic")

        # 3. Animasi
        self.stack.add_titled_with_icon(self._build_anim_page(), "anim", "Animasi", "system-run-symbolic")

        layout_grp.add(layout_row)

        tearing_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Screen Tearing",

        )

        layout_grp.add(tearing_row)

        # Celah

        gaps_in_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Celah Antar Jendela",
            adjustment=gaps_in_adj
        ))
        gaps_in_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: self._update_int("hyprland.gapsIn", r.get_value()))

        # Celah Antar Jendela Lanjutan (Tiap Sisi)

        in_top_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(title="Atas", adjustment=in_top_adj))
        in_top_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: self._update_int("hyprland.gapsInTop", r.get_value()))
        gaps_in_adv_row.add_row(in_top_row)

        in_right_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=backend.get("hyprland.gapsInRight", base_gaps_in), lower=0, upper=40, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        in_right_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(title="Kanan", adjustment=in_right_adj))
        in_right_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: self._update_int("hyprland.gapsInRight", r.get_value()))

    def _on_gaps_in_adv_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_enable_expansion()
        backend.set("hyprland.gapsInAdvanced", is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_gaps_out_adv_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_enable_expansion()
        backend.set("hyprland.gapsOutAdvanced", is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _on_custom_borders_toggled(self, row, param):
        is_active = row.get_active()
        backend.set("hyprland.customBorders", is_active)
        for r in self.border_color_rows:
            r.set_sensitive(is_active)
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _create_color_row(self, title, subtitle, key, default_val):
        row = Adw.ActionRow(title=title)
        if subtitle:
            row.set_subtitle(subtitle)
        color_dialog = Gtk.ColorDialog()
        color_dialog.set_title(title)
        color_dialog.set_with_alpha(True)

        btn = Gtk.ColorDialogButton(dialog=color_dialog)
        btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

        cur_val = backend.get(key, default_val)
        init_rgba = self._parse_hypr_color(cur_val)
        btn.set_rgba(init_rgba)

        def on_color_picked(button, param):
            rgba = button.get_rgba()
            hypr_color = self._rgba_to_hypr_color(rgba)
            backend.set(key, hypr_color)
            backend.apply_hyprland()

        btn.connect("notify::rgba", on_color_picked)
        row.add_suffix(btn)
        return row, btn

    def _on_reset_border_colors(self, button):
        defaults = {
            "hyprland.activeBorderDark": "rgba(33ffdcc6)",
            "hyprland.activeBorderLight": "rgba(88f700f7)",
            "hyprland.inactiveBorderDark": "rgba(23191933)",
            "hyprland.inactiveBorderLight": "rgba(8839ef33)",
        }
        for k, v in defaults.items():
            backend.set(k, v)

        self.btn_act_dark.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.activeBorderDark"]))
        self.btn_act_light.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.activeBorderLight"]))
        self.btn_inact_dark.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.inactiveBorderDark"]))
        self.btn_inact_light.set_rgba(self._parse_hypr_color(defaults["hyprland.inactiveBorderLight"]))

        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _parse_hypr_color(self, color_str):
        if not color_str:
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=0.5, green=0.5, blue=0.5, alpha=1.0)
        s = str(color_str).strip()
        if s.startswith("rgba(") and s.endswith(")"):
            hex_val = s[5:-1]
        elif s.startswith("rgb(") and s.endswith(")"):
            hex_val = s[4:-1]
        elif s.startswith("#"):
            hex_val = s[1:]
        elif s.startswith("0x"):
            hex_val = s[2:]
        else:
            hex_val = s

        if len(hex_val) == 8:
            r = int(hex_val[0:2], 16) / 255.0
            g = int(hex_val[2:4], 16) / 255.0
            b = int(hex_val[4:6], 16) / 255.0
            a = int(hex_val[6:8], 16) / 255.0
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=r, green=g, blue=b, alpha=a)
        elif len(hex_val) == 6:
            r = int(hex_val[0:2], 16) / 255.0
            g = int(hex_val[2:4], 16) / 255.0
            b = int(hex_val[4:6], 16) / 255.0
            a = int(hex_val[6:8], 16) / 255.0
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=r, green=g, blue=b, alpha=1.0)
        else:
            c = Gdk.RGBA()
            if c.parse(color_str):
                return c
            return Gdk.RGBA(red=0.2, green=1.0, blue=0.86, alpha=0.78)

    def _rgba_to_hypr_color(self, rgba):
        r = int(round(rgba.red * 255))
        g = int(round(rgba.green * 255))
        b = int(round(rgba.blue * 255))
        a = int(round(rgba.alpha * 255))
        return f"rgba({r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}{a:02x})"

    def _select_mode(self, mode):
        self._highlight_card(mode)
        backend.apply_gtk_theme(mode)

    def _highlight_card(self, mode):
        if mode == "light":
            self.btn_light.add_css_class("selected")
            self.btn_dark.remove_css_class("selected")
        else:
            self.btn_dark.add_css_class("selected")
            self.btn_light.remove_css_class("selected")

    def _build_accent_color_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Warna Aksen")
        self.append(group)

        # 1. Matugen wallpaper toggle
        self.auto_matugen_row = Adw.SwitchRow()
        self.auto_matugen_row.set_title("Warna Aksen Otomatis")
        self.auto_matugen_row.set_subtitle("Ekstrak palet warna dari wallpaper secara dinamis")
        use_wallpaper = backend.get("appearance.palette.useWallpaper", True)
        self.auto_matugen_row.set_active(use_wallpaper)
        group.add(self.auto_matugen_row)

        # 2. Preset Swatches Row
        self.manual_palette_row = Adw.PreferencesRow()
        self.manual_palette_row.set_activatable(False)
        self.manual_palette_row.set_selectable(False)

        swatches_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=10)
        swatches_box.set_halign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        swatches_box.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        swatches_box.set_margin_top(12)
        swatches_box.set_margin_bottom(12)
        swatches_box.set_margin_start(16)
        swatches_box.set_margin_end(16)

        self.swatch_buttons = []
        cur_accent = backend.get("appearance.palette.accentColor", "").lower()

        for name, hex_code, css_class in ACCENT_PRESETS:
            btn = Gtk.Button()
            btn.add_css_class("accent-swatch")
            btn.add_css_class(css_class)
            btn.set_tooltip_text(f"{name} ({hex_code})")

            icon = Gtk.Image.new_from_icon_name("object-select-symbolic")
            icon.set_pixel_size(16)
            btn.set_child(icon)

            is_selected = (cur_accent == hex_code.lower()) and not use_wallpaper
            if is_selected:
                btn.add_css_class("active")
                icon.set_visible(True)
            else:
                icon.set_visible(False)

            btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, h=hex_code: self._on_preset_clicked(h))
            swatches_box.append(btn)
            self.swatch_buttons.append((btn, hex_code, icon))

        self.manual_palette_row.set_child(swatches_box)
        group.add(self.manual_palette_row)

        # 3. Custom Color Row
        self.custom_color_row = Adw.ActionRow()
        self.custom_color_row.set_title("Warna Kustom")
        self.custom_color_row.set_subtitle("Pilih warna aksen kustom di luar palet preset")

        color_dialog = Gtk.ColorDialog()
        color_dialog.set_title("Pilih Warna Aksen")
        self.custom_color_btn = Gtk.ColorDialogButton(dialog=color_dialog)
        self.custom_color_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

        init_rgba = Gdk.RGBA()
        if cur_accent and cur_accent.startswith("#") and len(cur_accent) == 7:
            init_rgba.parse(cur_accent)
        else:
            init_rgba.parse("#3584e4")
        self.custom_color_btn.set_rgba(init_rgba)

        self.custom_color_btn.connect("notify::rgba", self._on_custom_color_picked)
        self.custom_color_row.add_suffix(self.custom_color_btn)
        group.add(self.custom_color_row)

        self._update_accent_sensitivity(use_wallpaper)
        self.auto_matugen_row.connect("notify::active", self._on_matugen_toggled)

    def _update_accent_sensitivity(self, use_wallpaper: bool):
        self.manual_palette_row.set_sensitive(not use_wallpaper)
        self.custom_color_row.set_sensitive(not use_wallpaper)

    def _select_accent_swatch(self, hex_color: str):
        found = False
        target = hex_color.lower()
        for btn, code, icon in self.swatch_buttons:
            if code.lower() == target:
                btn.add_css_class("active")
                icon.set_visible(True)
                found = True
            else:
                btn.remove_css_class("active")
                icon.set_visible(False)

        self._custom_color_updating = True
        rgba = Gdk.RGBA()
        if rgba.parse(hex_color):
            self.custom_color_btn.set_rgba(rgba)
        self._custom_color_updating = False

    def _on_matugen_toggled(self, row, param):
        if getattr(self, "_internal_update", False):
            return
        use_wallpaper = row.get_active()
        self._update_accent_sensitivity(use_wallpaper)
        backend.set_use_wallpaper_accent(use_wallpaper)
        if use_wallpaper:
            for btn, _, icon in self.swatch_buttons:
                btn.remove_css_class("active")
                icon.set_visible(False)
        else:
            cur_color = backend.get("appearance.palette.accentColor", "") or "#3584e4"
            self._select_accent_swatch(cur_color)

    def _on_preset_clicked(self, hex_code: str):
        self._select_accent_swatch(hex_code)
        if self.auto_matugen_row.get_active():
            self._internal_update = True
            self.auto_matugen_row.set_active(False)
            self._update_accent_sensitivity(False)
            self._internal_update = False
        backend.apply_accent_color(hex_code)

    def _on_custom_color_picked(self, btn, param):
        if getattr(self, "_custom_color_updating", False):
            return
        rgba = btn.get_rgba()
        hex_code = f"#{int(round(rgba.red * 255)):02x}{int(round(rgba.green * 255)):02x}{int(round(rgba.blue * 255)):02x}"
        if self.auto_matugen_row.get_active():
            self._internal_update = True
            self.auto_matugen_row.set_active(False)
            self._update_accent_sensitivity(False)
            self._internal_update = False
        self._select_accent_swatch(hex_code)
        backend.apply_accent_color(hex_code)

    def _build_transparency_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Transparansi")
        self.append(group)

        enable_trans_row = Adw.SwitchRow()
        enable_trans_row.set_title("Efek Transparansi")
        enable_trans_row.set_active(backend.get("appearance.transparency.enable", True))
        enable_trans_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.transparency.enable", r.get_active()))
        group.add(enable_trans_row)

        auto_trans_row = Adw.SwitchRow()
        auto_trans_row.set_title("Sesuaikan Otomatis")
        auto_trans_row.set_subtitle("Sesuaikan kepekatan mengikuti wallpaper")
        auto_trans_row.set_active(backend.get("appearance.transparency.automatic", True))
        auto_trans_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.transparency.automatic", r.get_active()))
        group.add(auto_trans_row)

        # Background Transparency
        bg_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=backend.get("appearance.transparency.backgroundTransparency", 0.11), lower=0.0, upper=1.0, step_increment=0.05, page_increment=0.1)
        bg_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Opasitas Latar Jendela",
            digits=2,
            adjustment=bg_adj
        ))
        bg_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.transparency.backgroundTransparency", round(r.get_value(), 2)))
        group.add(bg_row)

        # Content Transparency
        fg_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=backend.get("appearance.transparency.contentTransparency", 0.57), lower=0.0, upper=1.0, step_increment=0.05, page_increment=0.1)
        fg_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Opasitas Kartu dan Menu",
            digits=2,
            adjustment=fg_adj
        ))
        fg_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.transparency.contentTransparency", round(r.get_value(), 2)))
        group.add(fg_row)

import gi
gi.require_version("Gtk", "4.0")
gi.require_version("Adw", "1")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend

class GtkThemePage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self.installed_themes = backend.get_installed_gtk_themes()
        if not self.installed_themes:
            self.installed_themes = ["Adwaita", "Adwaita-dark", "WhiteSur-Dark", "WhiteSur-Light"]

        self._build_theme_selection_group()
        self._build_theming_harmony_group()
        self._build_terminal_props_group()

    def _build_theme_selection_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Tema GTK")
        self.append(group)

        # Light GTK Theme
        light_model = Gtk.StringList.new(self.installed_themes)
        self.light_combo = Adw.ComboRow(title="Tema Mode Terang", model=light_model)
        cur_light = backend.get("appearance.lightGtkTheme", "")
        if cur_light in self.installed_themes:
            self.light_combo.set_selected(self.installed_themes.index(cur_light))
        self.light_combo.connect("notify::selected", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.lightGtkTheme", self.installed_themes[r.get_selected()]))
        group.add(self.light_combo)

        # Dark GTK Theme
        dark_model = Gtk.StringList.new(self.installed_themes)
        self.dark_combo = Adw.ComboRow(title="Tema Mode Gelap", model=dark_model)
        cur_dark = backend.get("appearance.darkGtkTheme", "")
        if cur_dark in self.installed_themes:
            self.dark_combo.set_selected(self.installed_themes.index(cur_dark))
        self.dark_combo.connect("notify::selected", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.darkGtkTheme", self.installed_themes[r.get_selected()]))
        group.add(self.dark_combo)

        # Palette Type
        palette_labels = [
            "Otomatis",
            "Tonal Spot (Seimbang)",
            "Ekspresif",
            "Konten (Mendekati Asli)",
            "Fidelitas (Akurat)",
            "Monokrom",
            "Netral",
            "Pelangi"
        ]
        palette_values = [
            "auto",
            "scheme-tonal-spot",
            "scheme-expressive",
            "scheme-content",
            "scheme-fidelity",
            "scheme-monochrome",
            "scheme-neutral",
            "scheme-rainbow"
        ]
        palette_model = Gtk.StringList.new(palette_labels)
        palette_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title="Karakter Palet (Matugen)",
            subtitle="Gaya ekstraksi warna dari gambar latar",
            model=palette_model
        )
        cur_palette = backend.get("appearance.palette.type", "auto")
        if cur_palette in palette_values:
            palette_row.set_selected(palette_values.index(cur_palette))
        else:
            palette_row.set_selected(0)
        palette_row.connect("notify::selected", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.palette.type", palette_values[r.get_selected()]))
        group.add(palette_row)

        # Apply GTK Theme Action Row
        apply_row = Adw.ActionRow(title="Muat Ulang Tema", subtitle="Terapkan konfigurasi tema ke seluruh aplikasi")
        btn_apply = Gtk.Button(label="Terapkan")
        btn_apply.add_css_class("suggested-action")
        btn_apply.connect("clicked", lambda b: backend.apply_gtk_theme())
        apply_row.add_suffix(btn_apply)
        group.add(apply_row)

    def _build_theming_harmony_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Sinkronisasi Warna")
        self.append(group)

        # Shell and Utilities
        shell_row = Adw.SwitchRow(title="Panel dan Menu", subtitle="Samakan warna bar dan menu dengan wallpaper")
        shell_row.set_active(backend.get("appearance.wallpaperTheming.enableAppsAndShell", True))
        shell_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.wallpaperTheming.enableAppsAndShell", r.get_active()))
        group.add(shell_row)

        # Qt / KDE
        qt_row = Adw.SwitchRow(title="Aplikasi Qt", subtitle="Sesuaikan tema aplikasi Qt6 dan KDE")
        qt_row.set_active(backend.get("appearance.wallpaperTheming.enableQtApps", True))
        qt_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.wallpaperTheming.enableQtApps", r.get_active()))
        group.add(qt_row)

        # Terminal
        term_row = Adw.SwitchRow(title="Terminal (Kitty)", subtitle="Otomatiskan warna teks dan latar terminal")
        term_row.set_active(backend.get("appearance.wallpaperTheming.enableTerminal", True))
        term_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.wallpaperTheming.enableTerminal", r.get_active()))
        group.add(term_row)

        # Force Dark Terminal
        dark_term_row = Adw.SwitchRow(title="Paksa Terminal Selalu Gelap")
        dark_term_row.set_active(backend.get("appearance.wallpaperTheming.terminalGenerationProps.forceDarkMode", False))
        dark_term_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.wallpaperTheming.terminalGenerationProps.forceDarkMode", r.get_active()))
        group.add(dark_term_row)

    def _build_terminal_props_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Penyelarasan Terminal")
        self.append(group)

        # Harmony
        harmony_val = int(backend.get("appearance.wallpaperTheming.terminalGenerationProps.harmony", 0.6) * 100)
        harmony_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(harmony_val), lower=0, upper=100, step_increment=5, page_increment=10)
        harmony_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Tingkat Keselarasan (%)",
            adjustment=harmony_adj
        )
        harmony_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.wallpaperTheming.terminalGenerationProps.harmony", round(r.get_value() / 100.0, 2)))
        group.add(harmony_row)

        # Threshold
        thresh_val = int(backend.get("appearance.wallpaperTheming.terminalGenerationProps.harmonizeThreshold", 100))
        thresh_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(thresh_val), lower=0, upper=100, step_increment=5, page_increment=10)
        thresh_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Ambang Batas Penyesuaian",
            adjustment=thresh_adj
        )
        thresh_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.wallpaperTheming.terminalGenerationProps.harmonizeThreshold", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(thresh_row)

        # Fg Boost
        boost_val = int(backend.get("appearance.wallpaperTheming.terminalGenerationProps.termFgBoost", 0.35) * 100)
        boost_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(boost_val), lower=0, upper=100, step_increment=5, page_increment=10)
        boost_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Penguatan Kecerahan Teks (%)",
            adjustment=boost_adj
        )
        boost_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("appearance.wallpaperTheming.terminalGenerationProps.termFgBoost", round(r.get_value() / 100.0, 2)))

        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()

        )
        self.rounding_row.add_suffix(self.rounding_slider)
        self.rounding_slider.connect("value-changed", lambda s: backend.set("bar.rounding", int(s.get_value())))

        )
        self.scale_row.add_suffix(self.scale_slider)
        self.scale_slider.connect("value-changed", lambda s: backend.set("bar.panelScale", round(s.get_value(), 1)))
        group.add(self.scale_row)

        group_options = [
            "Kapsul Terpisah",
            "Tanpa Garis Tepi"
        ]
        group_model = Gtk.StringList.new(group_options)
        group_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title="Pemisah Modul",
            model=group_model
        )
        is_borderless = backend.get("bar.borderless", False)
        group_row.set_selected(1 if is_borderless else 0)
        group_row.connect("notify::selected", lambda r, p: backend.set("bar.borderless", r.get_selected() == 1))
        group.add(group_row)

        bg_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Latar Belakang Panel"
        )
        bg_row.set_active(backend.get("bar.showBackground", True))
        bg_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("bar.showBackground", r.get_active()))
        group.add(bg_row)

        theme_options = [
            "Selalu Gelap",
            "Ikuti Sistem",
            "Selalu Terang"
        ]
        theme_keys = ["dark", "system", "light"]
        theme_model = Gtk.StringList.new(theme_options)

            model=theme_model
        )

        theme_row.set_selected(cur_theme_idx)

        group.add(theme_row)

    def _on_pos_changed(self, row, param):
        idx = row.get_selected()
        if idx == 0:  # Top
            backend.set("bar.bottom", False)
            backend.set("bar.vertical", False)
        elif idx == 1:  # Left
            backend.set("bar.bottom", False)
            backend.set("bar.vertical", True)
        elif idx == 2:  # Bottom
            backend.set("bar.bottom", True)
            backend.set("bar.vertical", False)
        elif idx == 3:  # Right
            backend.set("bar.bottom", True)
            backend.set("bar.vertical", True)

    def _build_applet_editor_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Susunan Applet")
        self.append(group)

        preview_container = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=8)
        preview_container.add_css_class("card")
        preview_container.set_margin_bottom(12)
        preview_container.set_margin_top(4)

        preview_header = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8)
        preview_header.set_margin_start(14)
        preview_header.set_margin_end(14)
        preview_header.set_margin_top(10)

        preview_title = Gtk.Label(label="Pratinjau Panel")
        preview_title.add_css_class("heading")
        preview_title.set_hexpand(True)
        preview_title.set_xalign(0)
        preview_header.append(preview_title)

        reset_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("view-refresh-symbolic")
        reset_btn.set_tooltip_text("Reset ke Susunan Bawaan")
        reset_btn.add_css_class("flat")
        reset_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b: self._reset_applet_layout())
        preview_header.append(reset_btn)

        preview_container.append(preview_header)

        scrolled_preview = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
        scrolled_preview.set_policy(Gtk.PolicyType.AUTOMATIC, Gtk.PolicyType.NEVER)
        scrolled_preview.set_min_content_height(42)
        scrolled_preview.set_margin_start(12)
        scrolled_preview.set_margin_end(12)
        scrolled_preview.set_margin_bottom(12)

        self.preview_bar = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)
        self.preview_bar.add_css_class("panel-preview-bar")
        self.preview_bar.set_hexpand(True)

        self.preview_left_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=4)
        self.preview_center_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=4)
        self.preview_right_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=4)

        left_spacer = Gtk.Box()
        left_spacer.set_hexpand(True)

        right_spacer = Gtk.Box()
        right_spacer.set_hexpand(True)

        self.preview_bar.append(self.preview_left_box)
        self.preview_bar.append(left_spacer)
        self.preview_bar.append(self.preview_center_box)
        self.preview_bar.append(right_spacer)
        self.preview_bar.append(self.preview_right_box)

        scrolled_preview.set_child(self.preview_bar)
        preview_container.append(scrolled_preview)
        group.add(preview_container)

        self.current_zone = "left"

        zone_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=0)

HOME = os.getenv("HOME")

function is_file_exists(name)
   local f = io.open(name, "r")
   if f ~= nil then
      io.close(f)
      return true
   else
      return false
   end
end

function create_if_not_exists(path)
   if not is_file_exists(path) then
      os.execute("mkdir -p \"$(dirname \"" .. path .. "\")\"")
      os.execute("echo '-- This file will not be overwritten across dots-hyprland updates.\n-- The file name is for the sake of organization and does not matter\n-- See the corresponding files in ~/.config/hypr/hyprland for examples' > \"" .. path .. "\"")
      return true
   end
   return false
end

function workspace_in_group(i)
    local curr = hl.get_active_workspace().id
    local newVal = math.floor((curr - 1) / workspaceGroupSize) * workspaceGroupSize + i
    -- hl.notification.create({ text = "curr " .. curr .. " floor " .. math.floor(curr / 10) .. " new " .. newVal, duration = 5000 })
    return newVal
end

import gi
gi.require_version("Gtk", "4.0")
gi.require_version("Adw", "1")
gi.require_version("Pango", "1.0")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw, Gio, GLib, GObject, Pango
from backend import backend

class AppItem(GObject.Object):
    def __init__(self, app_id, name, icon, exec_bin):
        super().__init__()
        self.app_id = app_id
        self.name = name
        self.icon = icon
        self.exec_bin = exec_bin

def _create_app_factory():
    factory = Gtk.SignalListItemFactory()

    def _setup(f, list_item):
        box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=10)
        box.set_margin_top(4)
        box.set_margin_bottom(4)
        box.set_margin_start(4)
        box.set_margin_end(4)

        img = Gtk.Image()
        img.set_pixel_size(24)

        lbl = Gtk.Label(xalign=0)
        lbl.set_ellipsize(Pango.EllipsizeMode.END)

        box.append(img)
        box.append(lbl)
        list_item.set_child(box)

    def _bind(f, list_item):
        item = list_item.get_item()
        if not item:
            return
        box = list_item.get_child()
        img = box.get_first_child()
        lbl = img.get_next_sibling()
        lbl.set_text(item.name)

        icon_str = item.icon or "application-x-executable"
        try:
            gicon = Gio.Icon.new_for_string(icon_str)
            img.set_from_gicon(gicon)
        except Exception:
            img.set_from_icon_name("application-x-executable")

    factory.connect("setup", _setup)
    factory.connect("bind", _bind)
    return factory


class DefaultAppsPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self.is_loading = False
        self.cat_defs = {}
        self.groups_widgets = {}
        self.rows_widgets = {}

        self._build_category_groups()
        GLib.idle_add(lambda: self._load_data(force_reload=False) or False)

    def _build_category_groups(self):
        group_specs = [
            ("core", "Aplikasi Utama", "Terminal, peramban web, dan pengelola berkas"),
            ("productivity", "Dokumen & Teks", "Pengolah kata, editor teks, kode, lembar sebar, dan presentasi"),
            ("media", "Multimedia", "Foto, rekaman video, dan pemutar musik"),
            ("utility", "Utilitas", "Pengelola arsip kompresi dan surel")
        ]

        for idx, (gid, gtitle, gdesc) in enumerate(group_specs):
            group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
            group.set_title(GLib.markup_escape_text(gtitle))
            
            # Tombol Segarkan di pojok kanan judul grup pertama
            if idx == 0:
                self.refresh_btn = Gtk.Button()
                self.refresh_btn.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
                self.refresh_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                refresh_btn_box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=6)
                refresh_icon = Gtk.Image.new_from_icon_name("view-refresh-symbolic")
                self.refresh_label = Gtk.Label(label="Segarkan")
                refresh_btn_box.append(refresh_icon)
                refresh_btn_box.append(self.refresh_label)
                self.refresh_btn.set_child(refresh_btn_box)
                self.refresh_btn.set_tooltip_text("Pindai ulang aplikasi terpasang di sistem")
                self.refresh_btn.connect("clicked", self._on_refresh_clicked)
                group.set_header_suffix(self.refresh_btn)

            self.append(group)

            self.groups_widgets[gid] = group

    def _on_refresh_clicked(self, btn):
        if hasattr(self, "refresh_label"):
            self.refresh_label.set_text("Memindai...")
        if hasattr(self, "refresh_btn"):
            self.refresh_btn.set_sensitive(False)
        self._load_data(force_reload=True)
        GLib.timeout_add(500, self._reset_refresh_button)

    def _reset_refresh_button(self):
        if hasattr(self, "refresh_label"):
            self.refresh_label.set_text("Segarkan")
        if hasattr(self, "refresh_btn"):
            self.refresh_btn.set_sensitive(True)
        return False

    def refresh_page(self):
        self._load_data(force_reload=True)

    def _load_data(self, force_reload=False):
        self.is_loading = True
        data = backend.get_default_apps_data(force_reload=force_reload)

        # Hapus baris lama jika ada
        for row in self.rows_widgets.values():
            parent = row.get_parent()
            if parent:
                parent.remove(row)
        self.rows_widgets.clear()
        self.cat_defs.clear()

        for cat_entry in data:
            definition = cat_entry["definition"]
            cat_id = definition["id"]
            group_id = definition.get("group_id", "core")
            current_default_id = cat_entry["current_default_id"]
            apps = cat_entry["apps"]

            self.cat_defs[cat_id] = definition
            group = self.groups_widgets.get(group_id)
            if not group:
                continue

            row = Adw.ComboRow()
            row.set_title(GLib.markup_escape_text(definition["title"]))
            row.set_subtitle(GLib.markup_escape_text(definition.get("subtitle", "")))

            prefix_icon = Gtk.Image.new_from_icon_name(definition.get("icon", "application-x-executable"))
            prefix_icon.set_pixel_size(20)
            row.add_prefix(prefix_icon)

            store = Gio.ListStore(item_type=AppItem)
            selected_idx = 0

            if not apps:
                placeholder = AppItem("", "Tidak ada aplikasi terdeteksi", "dialog-warning-symbolic", "")
                store.append(placeholder)
                row.set_sensitive(False)
                row.set_subtitle("Tidak ditemukan aplikasi yang cocok")
            else:
                match_found = False
                for idx, app in enumerate(apps):
                    item = AppItem(app["id"], app["name"], app["icon"], app.get("exec", ""))
                    store.append(item)
                    if not match_found and (app["id"] == current_default_id or app["id"].split(".")[0] == current_default_id):
                        selected_idx = idx
                        match_found = True

                row.set_sensitive(True)

            row.set_model(store)
            row.set_factory(_create_app_factory())
            row.set_list_factory(_create_app_factory())

            if apps:
                row.set_selected(selected_idx)
                row.connect("notify::selected", self._on_app_selected, cat_id, store)

            group.add(row)
            self.rows_widgets[cat_id] = row

        self.is_loading = False

    def _on_app_selected(self, row, param, cat_id, store):
        if self.is_loading:
            return

        sel_idx = row.get_selected()
        if sel_idx < 0 or sel_idx >= store.get_n_items():
            return

        item = store.get_item(sel_idx)
        if not item or not item.app_id:
            return

        app_info = {
            "id": item.app_id,
            "name": item.name,
            "icon": item.icon,
            "exec": item.exec_bin
        }

        backend.set_default_app(cat_id, item.app_id, app_info)

    def set_default_app(self, cat_id, app_id, app_info=None):
        self._check_and_reload()
        cat_def = None
        for c in DEFAULT_APP_CATEGORIES:
            if c["id"] == cat_id:
                cat_def = c
                break
        if not cat_def:
            return False

        self.set(f"apps.defaults.{cat_id}", app_id)

        exec_bin = app_info.get("exec", "") if app_info else ""
        if not exec_bin:
            nid = app_id[:-8] if app_id.endswith(".desktop") else app_id
            exec_bin = nid
        exec_base = os.path.basename(exec_bin)

        if cat_def["type"] == "terminal":
            self.set("apps.terminal", exec_base)
            self.generate_variables_lua()
            self.generate_keybinds_apps_lua()
            self._update_env_terminal(exec_base)
            self.apply_hyprland()
            return True

        mimes = cat_def.get("mimes", [])
        for m in mimes:
            try:
                app_obj = Gio.DesktopAppInfo.new(app_id)
                if app_obj:
                    app_obj.set_as_default_for_type(m)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                subprocess.Popen(["xdg-mime", "default", app_id, m], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if cat_id == "web_browser":
            try:
                subprocess.Popen(["xdg-settings", "set", "default-web-browser", app_id], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.set("apps.browser", exec_base)
            self.generate_variables_lua()
            self.generate_keybinds_apps_lua()
            self.apply_hyprland()
        elif cat_id == "file_manager":
            self.set("apps.fileManager", exec_base)
            self.generate_variables_lua()
            self.generate_keybinds_apps_lua()
            self.apply_hyprland()
        elif cat_id == "code_editor":
            self.set("apps.codeEditor", exec_base)
            self.generate_variables_lua()
            self.generate_keybinds_apps_lua()
            self.apply_hyprland()
        elif cat_id == "text_editor":
            self.generate_variables_lua()
            self.apply_hyprland()

        return True

        self.generate_env_lua()

    def _build_user_execs_group(self):
        self.user_group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        self.user_group.set_title("Aplikasi Startup")
        
        # Header bar button
        add_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("list-add-symbolic")
        add_btn.set_tooltip_text("Tambah Aplikasi Startup Baru")
        add_btn.add_css_class("flat")
        add_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b: self._show_add_dialog())
        self.user_group.set_header_suffix(add_btn)

        self.append(self.user_group)
        self._refresh_user_rows()

    def _refresh_user_rows(self):
        for row in self.user_rows:
            self.user_group.remove(row)
        self.user_rows.clear()

        execs = backend.get_execs()
        if not execs:
            empty_row = Adw.ActionRow(
                title="Belum Ada Aplikasi Startup Kustom",
                subtitle="Klik tombol tambah (+) di sudut kanan atas untuk menambahkan aplikasi"
            )
            empty_row.set_sensitive(False)
            self.user_group.add(empty_row)
            self.user_rows.append(empty_row)
            return

        for idx, item in enumerate(execs):
            row = Adw.ActionRow(
                title=item.get("name", "Aplikasi"),
                subtitle=item.get("command", "")
            )

            sw = Gtk.Switch()
            sw.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
            sw.set_active(item.get("enabled", True))

            edit_btn.add_css_class("circular")
            edit_btn.set_tooltip_text("Edit Aplikasi Startup")

            btn_box.append(edit_btn)

            # Delete button
            del_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("user-trash-symbolic")

    def get_execs(self):
        self._check_and_reload()

    def save_execs(self, execs_list):

    def generate_execs_lua(self):
        execs_lua_path = os.path.expanduser("~/.config/hypr/custom/execs.lua")
        execs = self.get_execs()
        disabled = self.get_disabled_base_execs()

        lines = [
            "-- File ini dihasilkan otomatis oleh Pengaturan Desktop (Autostart & Layanan)",
            "-- JANGAN mengedit berkas ini secara manual karena akan tertimpa saat disimpan di GUI.",
            "",
            "-- Daftar layanan bawaan sistem yang dinonaktifkan secara non-destruktif",
            "_G.disabled_base_execs = {",
        ]
        for tag in sorted(disabled):
            lines.append(f'\t["{tag}"] = true,')
        lines.append("}")
        lines.append("disabled_base_execs = _G.disabled_base_execs")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append('hl.on("hyprland.start", function()')

        for item in execs:
            if item.get("enabled", True):
                cmd = item.get("command", "").strip()
                name = item.get("name", "Aplikasi")
                if cmd:
                    cmd_lua = cmd.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"')
                    lines.append(f'\t-- {name}')
                    lines.append(f'\thl.exec_cmd("{cmd_lua}")')

        lines.append("end)")
        lines.append("")

        self._atomic_write_lua(execs_lua_path, "\n".join(lines))

    def get_env(self):
        self._check_and_reload()
        return {
            "xcursor_size": self.get("hyprland.env.xcursor_size", 24),

    def save_env(self, env_data):
        self.set("hyprland.env", env_data, auto_apply=False)
        self.generate_env_lua()

    def generate_env_lua(self):
        env_lua_path = os.path.expanduser("~/.config/hypr/custom/env.lua")
        env_data = self.get_env()
        term = self.get("apps.terminal", "kitty -1")

        lines = [
            "-- File ini dihasilkan otomatis oleh Pengaturan Desktop (Variabel Sesi)",
            "-- JANGAN mengedit berkas ini secara manual karena akan tertimpa saat disimpan di GUI.",
            "",
            f'hl.env("TERMINAL", "{term}")',
            f'hl.env("XCURSOR_SIZE", "{env_data.get("xcursor_size", 24)}")',
            f'hl.env("HYPRCURSOR_SIZE", "{env_data.get("xcursor_size", 24)}")',
            f'hl.env("ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT", "{env_data.get("electron_platform", "auto")}")',
        ]

        if env_data.get("moz_wayland", True):
            lines.append('hl.env("MOZ_ENABLE_WAYLAND", "1")')

        driver = env_data.get("libva_driver", "iHD")
        if driver and driver != "auto":
            lines.append(f'hl.env("LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME", "{driver}")')

        for cv in env_data.get("custom_vars", []):
            k = cv.get("key", "").strip()
            v = cv.get("val", "").strip()
            if k:
                k_lua = k.replace('"', '\\"')
                v_lua = v.replace('"', '\\"')
                lines.append(f'hl.env("{k_lua}", "{v_lua}")')

        lines.append("")
        self._atomic_write_lua(env_lua_path, "\n".join(lines))

    def generate_rules_lua(self):
        rules_lua_path = os.path.expanduser("~/.config/hypr/custom/rules.lua")
        rules = self.get_window_rules()

        new_ws_behavior = self.get("hyprland.tiling.newWorkspaceBehavior", "tiled")

        lines = [
            "-- File ini dihasilkan otomatis oleh Pengaturan Desktop (Window Management)",
            "-- JANGAN mengedit berkas ini secara manual karena akan tertimpa saat disimpan di GUI.",
            ""
        ]

        if new_ws_behavior == "floating":
            lines.extend([
                "-- Perilaku Bawaan Ruang Kerja Baru: Melayang Bebas",
                'hl.window_rule({ match = { class = ".*" }, float = true })',
                ""
            ])

        for r in rules:
            name = r.get("name", "Aturan")
            cls = r.get("class", "").strip()
            title = r.get("title", "").strip()
            raw_mode = str(r.get("mode", "tile")).lower()
            mode = "float" if raw_mode in ("float", "floating") else "tile"
            size_w = max(0.10, min(1.00, float(r.get("size_w", r.get("width_scale", 0.60)))))
            size_h = max(0.10, min(1.00, float(r.get("size_h", r.get("height_scale", 0.60)))))
            center = bool(r.get("center", True))

            if not cls and not title:
                continue

            match_parts = []
            if cls:
                cls_lua = cls.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"')
                match_parts.append(f'class = "{cls_lua}"')
            if title:
                title_lua = title.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"')
                match_parts.append(f'title = "{title_lua}"')
            match_str = ", ".join(match_parts)

            lines.append(f"-- {name}")
            props = [f"match = {{ {match_str} }}"]

            if mode == "float":
                props.append("float = true")
                if center:
                    props.append("center = true")
                props.append(f'size = {{ "(monitor_w*{size_w:.2f})", "(monitor_h*{size_h:.2f})" }}')
                if r.get("keep_aspect_ratio"):
                    props.append("keep_aspect_ratio = true")
            else:
                props.append("tile = true")

            # Transparansi & Opacity
            if r.get("custom_opacity"):
                op_mode = r.get("opacity_mode", "custom")
                if op_mode == "opaque":
                    props.append("opaque = true")
                else:
                    op_act = max(0.0, min(1.00, float(r.get("opacity_active", 0.88))))
                    op_inact = max(0.0, min(1.00, float(r.get("opacity_inactive", 0.85))))
                    props.append(f'opacity = "{op_act:.2f} {op_inact:.2f}"')

            # Efek Kaca Buram (Blur)
            if r.get("blur"):
                props.append("no_blur = false")

            # Sematkan di semua ruang kerja (Pin)
            if r.get("pin"):
                props.append("pin = true")

import gi
gi.require_version("Gtk", "4.0")
gi.require_version("Adw", "1")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw, Gio
import subprocess
from backend import backend
from app_detector import AppDetector
from widgets import enhance_spin_row, NumericSlider

class LauncherPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_engine_group()
        self._build_gnome_group()
        self._build_dock_group()
        self._build_dock_apps_group()
        self._build_illogical_group()
        self._build_macos_group()
        self._build_timeout_group()

        # Update initial visibility based on saved engine
        self._update_visibility(backend.get("launcher.type", "gnome"))

    def _build_engine_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Gaya Peluncur")
        self.append(group)

        self.engine_types = ["gnome", "illogical", "macos"]
        engine_labels = [
            "GNOME Launcher",
            "Illogical Impulse (Klasik)",
            "macOS Launchpad"
        ]

        string_list = Gtk.StringList.new(engine_labels)
        self.engine_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title="Gaya Peluncur",
            model=string_list
        )

        current_engine = backend.get("launcher.type", "gnome")
        if current_engine in self.engine_types:
            self.engine_row.set_selected(self.engine_types.index(current_engine))
        else:
            self.engine_row.set_selected(0)

        self.engine_row.connect("notify::selected", self._on_engine_changed)
        group.add(self.engine_row)

    def _on_engine_changed(self, row, param):
        idx = row.get_selected()
        if 0 <= idx < len(self.engine_types):
            selected_type = self.engine_types[idx]
            backend.set("launcher.type", selected_type)
            self._update_visibility(selected_type)

    def _update_visibility(self, engine_type):
        is_gnome = (engine_type == "gnome")
        self.gnome_group.set_visible(is_gnome)
        self.dock_group.set_visible(is_gnome)
        self.dock_apps_group.set_visible(is_gnome)
        self.illogical_group.set_visible(engine_type == "illogical")
        self.macos_group.set_visible(engine_type == "macos")

    def _build_gnome_group(self):
        self.gnome_group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        self.gnome_group.set_title("GNOME Launcher")
        self.append(self.gnome_group)

        # Default mode upon opening
        mode_labels = [
            "Tinjauan Jendela",
            "Kisi Aplikasi"
        ]
        mode_list = Gtk.StringList.new(mode_labels)
        mode_row = Adw.ComboRow(
            title="Tampilan Awal Saat Dibuka",
                        model=mode_list
        )
        saved_mode = backend.get("launcher.gnome.defaultMode", 0)
        mode_row.set_selected(1 if saved_mode == 1 else 0)
        mode_row.connect("notify::selected", lambda r, p: backend.set("launcher.gnome.defaultMode", int(r.get_selected())))
        self.gnome_group.add(mode_row)

        # App Grid Columns
        cols_val = backend.get("launcher.gnome.appGridColumns", 8)
        cols_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(cols_val), lower=4, upper=12, step_increment=1, page_increment=1)
        cols_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Kolom Kisi Aplikasi",
            adjustment=cols_adj
        ))
        cols_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("launcher.gnome.appGridColumns", int(r.get_value())))
        self.gnome_group.add(cols_row)

        self.refresh_btn.add_css_class("flat")

        self.refresh_btn.set_tooltip_text("Segarkan Semua Pengaturan & Pindai Ulang Sistem (F5)")
        self.refresh_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b: self.refresh_all_settings())
        self.content_hb.pack_end(self.refresh_btn)

        content_tb.add_top_bar(self.content_hb)

        self.stack = Gtk.Stack()
        self.stack.set_transition_type(Gtk.StackTransitionType.CROSSFADE)
        self.stack.set_transition_duration(150)

        # Lazy containers for all pages clamped to GNOME HIG max 800px
        self.page_instances = {}
        self.page_clamps = {}
        self.preload_queue = []

        for page_id, spec in PAGE_SPECS.items():
            clamp = Adw.Clamp(maximum_size=800, tightening_threshold=600)
            self.page_clamps[page_id] = clamp

            # Clean lightweight placeholder
            placeholder = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=12)
            placeholder.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
            placeholder.set_halign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)
            spinner = Gtk.Spinner()
            spinner.set_size_request(32, 32)
            spinner.start()
            placeholder.append(spinner)
            clamp.set_child(placeholder)

            scrolled = Gtk.ScrolledWindow()
            scrolled.set_vexpand(True)
            scrolled.set_hexpand(True)
            scrolled.set_child(clamp)

            self.stack.add_named(scrolled, page_id)

        # Wrap content in ToastOverlay
        self.toast_overlay = Adw.ToastOverlay()
        self.toast_overlay.set_child(self.stack)
        content_tb.set_content(self.toast_overlay)

        target_page = initial_page if initial_page in PAGE_SPECS else "appearance"
        init_title = PAGE_SPECS.get(target_page, (None, None, "Tampilan"))[2]
        self.content_nav_page = Adw.NavigationPage.new(content_tb, init_title)
        self.split_view.set_content(self.content_nav_page)

        self.set_content(self.split_view)

        # Keyboard shortcuts: F5 & Ctrl+R for global refresh, Escape to hide
        shortcut_ctrl = Gtk.ShortcutController.new()
        shortcut_ctrl.set_scope(Gtk.ShortcutScope.GLOBAL)
        trigger_f5 = Gtk.ShortcutTrigger.parse_string("F5")
        action_f5 = Gtk.CallbackAction.new(lambda w, a: self.refresh_all_settings() or True)
        shortcut_ctrl.add_shortcut(Gtk.Shortcut.new(trigger_f5, action_f5))

        trigger_ctrl_r = Gtk.ShortcutTrigger.parse_string("<Primary>r")
        action_ctrl_r = Gtk.CallbackAction.new(lambda w, a: self.refresh_all_settings() or True)
        shortcut_ctrl.add_shortcut(Gtk.Shortcut.new(trigger_ctrl_r, action_ctrl_r))

        trigger_esc = Gtk.ShortcutTrigger.parse_string("Escape")
        action_esc = Gtk.CallbackAction.new(lambda w, a: (self.set_visible(False) or True))
        shortcut_ctrl.add_shortcut(Gtk.Shortcut.new(trigger_esc, action_esc))
        self.add_controller(shortcut_ctrl)

        # Tier 1: Select and load initial page immediately
        self._load_page(target_page)
        self.sidebar.select_page(target_page)
        self._on_page_selected(target_page)

        # Tier 2: Progressive background preloader
        GLib.idle_add(self._start_background_preloader)

    def _load_page(self, page_id):
        if page_id in self.page_instances:
            return self.page_instances[page_id]

        if page_id not in PAGE_SPECS:
            return None

        mod_name, cls_name, _ = PAGE_SPECS[page_id]
        try:
            mod = importlib.import_module(mod_name)
            page_cls = getattr(mod, cls_name)
            page_widget = page_cls()
            self.page_instances[page_id] = page_widget

            if page_id in self.page_clamps:
                self.page_clamps[page_id].set_child(page_widget)

            return page_widget
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error loading page {page_id}: {e}")
            return None

import gi
gi.require_version("Gtk", "4.0")
gi.require_version("Adw", "1")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend
from widgets import enhance_spin_row

class LockPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_lock_group()

    def _build_lock_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Layar Kunci")
        self.append(group)

        # Hyprlock vs Quickshell
        backend_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Gunakan Hyprlock",
            subtitle="Layar kunci bawaan yang cepat dan ringan"
        )
        backend_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.useHyprlock", False))
        backend_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.useHyprlock", r.get_active()))
        group.add(backend_row)

        # Blur lockscreen
        blur_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Buramkan Latar Belakang"
        )
        blur_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.blur.enable", True))
        blur_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.blur.enable", r.get_active()))
        group.add(blur_row)

        # Blur extra zoom
        zoom_val = backend.get("lock.blur.extraZoom", 1.1) * 100
        zoom_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(zoom_val), lower=100, upper=150, step_increment=5, page_increment=10)
        zoom_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Perbesaran Blur Latar (%)",
            adjustment=zoom_adj
        ))
        zoom_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.blur.extraZoom", round(r.get_value() / 100.0, 2)))
        group.add(zoom_row)

        # Center clock
        center_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Jam di Tengah Layar"
        )
        center_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.centerClock", True))
        center_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.centerClock", r.get_active()))
        group.add(center_row)

        # Show locked text
        locked_text_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Teks Status Terkunci"
        )
        locked_text_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.showLockedText", True))
        locked_text_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.showLockedText", r.get_active()))
        group.add(locked_text_row)

        # Varied shapes for password dots
        shape_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Variasi Bentuk Titik Sandi"
        )
        shape_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.materialShapeChars", True))
        shape_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.materialShapeChars", r.get_active()))
        group.add(shape_row)

        # Password to power
        power_pwd_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Wajib Sandi untuk Mematikan",
            subtitle="Minta kata sandi sebelum mematikan dari layar kunci"
        )
        power_pwd_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.security.requirePasswordToPower", False))
        power_pwd_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.security.requirePasswordToPower", r.get_active()))
        group.add(power_pwd_row)

        # Unlock keyring
        keyring_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Buka Kunci Keyring Otomatis",
            subtitle="Buka dompet sandi aplikasi saat berhasil masuk"
        )
        keyring_row.set_active(backend.get("lock.security.unlockKeyring", True))
        keyring_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("lock.security.unlockKeyring", r.get_active()))
        group.add(keyring_row)

DockLockPage = LockPage

    def get_window_rules(self):
        self._check_and_reload()
        rules = self.get("hyprland.windowRules")
        if isinstance(rules, list) and len(rules) > 0:
            self._save_rules_json_backup(rules)
            return rules

        if os.path.exists(self.RULES_JSON_PATH):
            try:
                with open(self.RULES_JSON_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    cached_rules = json.load(f)
                if isinstance(cached_rules, list) and len(cached_rules) > 0:
                    self.set("hyprland.windowRules", cached_rules, auto_apply=False)
                    return cached_rules
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error reading rules.json backup: {e}")

        recovered = self.parse_rules_from_lua()
        if recovered:
            self._save_rules_json_backup(recovered)
            self.set("hyprland.windowRules", recovered, auto_apply=False)
            return recovered

        return []

    def save_window_rules(self, rules_list):
        self._check_and_reload()
        self._save_rules_json_backup(rules_list)
        self.set("hyprland.windowRules", rules_list, auto_apply=False)
        self.generate_rules_lua()

from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend

class AudioPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_protection_group()
        self._build_sounds_group()

    def _build_protection_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Proteksi Volume")
        self.append(group)

        # Enable protection
        prot_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Batas Lonjakan Volume",
            subtitle="Cegah kenaikan volume suara yang melonjak mendadak"
        )
        prot_row.set_active(backend.get("audio.protection.enable", False))
        prot_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("audio.protection.enable", r.get_active()))
        group.add(prot_row)

        # Max allowed increase
        inc_val = backend.get("audio.protection.maxAllowedIncrease", 10)
        inc_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(inc_val), lower=1, upper=50, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        inc_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Maksimal Kenaikan per Langkah (%)",
            adjustment=inc_adj
        )
        inc_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("audio.protection.maxAllowedIncrease", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(inc_row)

        # Max allowed absolute
        max_val = backend.get("audio.protection.maxAllowed", 99)
        max_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(max_val), lower=50, upper=153, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        max_row = Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Batas Volume Maksimal (%)",
            adjustment=max_adj
        )
        max_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("audio.protection.maxAllowed", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(max_row)

    def _build_sounds_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Efek Suara")
        self.append(group)

        # Battery sound
        bat_sound_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Suara Pengisi Daya",
            subtitle="Bunyi saat kabel daya dicolok atau dicabut"
        )
        bat_sound_row.set_active(backend.get("sounds.battery", True))
        bat_sound_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("sounds.battery", r.get_active()))
        group.add(bat_sound_row)

        # Pomodoro sound
        pomo_sound_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Suara Pomodoro",
            subtitle="Bunyi saat sesi fokus atau istirahat selesai"
        )
        pomo_sound_row.set_active(backend.get("sounds.pomodoro", True))
        pomo_sound_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("sounds.pomodoro", r.get_active()))
        group.add(pomo_sound_row)

import gi
gi.require_version("Gtk", "4.0")
gi.require_version("Adw", "1")
from gi.repository import Gtk, Adw
from backend import backend
from widgets import enhance_spin_row

class PowerPage(Gtk.Box):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=16)
        self.set_margin_top(28)
        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_warnings_group()
        self._build_suspend_group()

    def _build_warnings_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Peringatan Baterai")
        self.append(group)

        # Low warning
        low_val = backend.get("battery.low", 20)
        low_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(low_val), lower=10, upper=40, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        low_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Baterai Lemah (%)",
            subtitle="Pengingat saat baterai mulai menipis",
            adjustment=low_adj
        ))
        low_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.low", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(low_row)

        # Critical warning
        crit_val = backend.get("battery.critical", 5)
        crit_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(crit_val), lower=3, upper=15, step_increment=1, page_increment=2)
        crit_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Baterai Kritis (%)",
            subtitle="Peringatan mendesak sebelum daya habis",
            adjustment=crit_adj
        ))
        crit_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.critical", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(crit_row)

        # Full charge warning (101 = disabled)
        full_val = backend.get("battery.full", 101)
        full_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(full_val), lower=50, upper=101, step_increment=1, page_increment=5)
        full_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Baterai Penuh (%)",
            subtitle="Pengingat lepas kabel daya (atur 101 untuk nonaktifkan)",
            adjustment=full_adj
        ))
        full_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.full", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(full_row)

    def _build_suspend_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Hemat Daya")
        self.append(group)

        # Automatic suspend switch
        auto_suspend_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Suspensi Otomatis",
            subtitle="Alihkan komputer ke mode tidur saat baterai kritis"
        )
        auto_suspend_row.set_active(backend.get("battery.automaticSuspend", True))
        auto_suspend_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.automaticSuspend", r.get_active()))
        group.add(auto_suspend_row)

        # Suspend threshold
        suspend_val = backend.get("battery.suspend", 3)
        suspend_adj = Gtk.Adjustment(value=float(suspend_val), lower=1, upper=10, step_increment=1, page_increment=1)
        suspend_row = enhance_spin_row(Adw.SpinRow(
            title="Ambang Batas Suspensi (%)",
            adjustment=suspend_adj
        ))
        suspend_row.connect("notify::value", lambda r, p: backend.set("battery.suspend", int(r.get_value())))
        group.add(suspend_row)

class SearchSafetyPage(Gtk.Box):

        self.set_margin_bottom(24)
        self.set_margin_start(24)
        self.set_margin_end(24)

        self._build_work_safety_group()
        self._build_save_paths_group()

    def _build_work_safety_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Penyaringan Konten")
        self.append(group)

        # Wallpaper filter
        wall_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Sembunyikan Wallpaper Pribadi di Jaringan Publik",
            subtitle="Otomatis beralih ke latar netral saat di Wi-Fi publik atau kantor"
        )
        wall_row.set_active(backend.get("workSafety.enable.wallpaper", True))
        wall_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("workSafety.enable.wallpaper", r.get_active()))
        group.add(wall_row)

        # Clipboard filter
        clip_safe_row = Adw.SwitchRow(
            title="Sensor Gambar di Riwayat Papan Klip",
            subtitle="Buramkan pratinjau gambar sensitif pada riwayat clipboard"
        )
        clip_safe_row.set_active(backend.get("workSafety.enable.clipboard", False))
        clip_safe_row.connect("notify::active", lambda r, p: backend.set("workSafety.enable.clipboard", r.get_active()))
        group.add(clip_safe_row)

    def _build_save_paths_group(self):
        group = Adw.PreferencesGroup()
        group.set_title("Lokasi Penyimpanan Media")
        self.append(group)

        rec_row = Adw.EntryRow(title="Folder Rekaman Layar")
        rec_row.set_text(backend.get("screenRecord.savePath", "~/Videos"))
        rec_row.set_show_apply_button(True)
        rec_row.connect("apply", lambda r: backend.set("screenRecord.savePath", r.get_text()))
        group.add(rec_row)

        snip_row = Adw.EntryRow(title="Folder Tangkapan Layar")
        snip_path = backend.get("screenSnip.savePath", "")
        snip_row.set_text(snip_path)
        snip_row.set_tooltip_text("Kosongkan untuk hanya menyalin ke papan klip tanpa menyimpan berkas")
        snip_row.set_show_apply_button(True)
        snip_row.connect("apply", lambda r: backend.set("screenSnip.savePath", r.get_text()))
        group.add(snip_row)

    def _move_applet(self, index, direction):
        layout = self._get_layout()
        items = layout.get(self.current_zone, [])
        new_idx = index + direction
        if 0 <= new_idx < len(items):
            items[index], items[new_idx] = items[new_idx], items[index]
            layout[self.current_zone] = items
            self._save_layout(layout)

    def _transfer_applet(self, aid, target_zone, popover):
        popover.popdown()
        layout = self._get_layout()
        if aid in layout.get(self.current_zone, []):
            layout[self.current_zone].remove(aid)
        if aid not in layout.get(target_zone, []):
            layout[target_zone].append(aid)
        self._save_layout(layout)

    def _remove_applet(self, aid):
        layout = self._get_layout()
        if aid in layout.get(self.current_zone, []):
            layout[self.current_zone].remove(aid)
            self._save_layout(layout)

    def _add_applet(self, aid, popover):
        popover.popdown()
        layout = self._get_layout()
        if aid not in layout.get(self.current_zone, []):
            layout[self.current_zone].append(aid)
            self._save_layout(layout)

        def _on_dot_style_changed(row, param):

    def _on_opacity_changed(self, scale):
        val = int(scale.get_value())
        backend.set("bar.opacity", val)

    def _on_blur_changed(self, scale):
        val = int(scale.get_value())
        is_enabled = (val > 0)
        backend.set("bar.blur", is_enabled)
        backend.set("bar.blurStrength", val)
        if is_enabled:
            size = max(1, min(20, round(val / 100.0 * 20)))
            passes = max(1, min(4, round(1 + val / 100.0 * 3)))
            backend.set("hyprland.blurSize", size)
            backend.set("hyprland.blurPasses", passes)
            backend.set("hyprland.blurEnabled", True)
            try:
                subprocess.Popen([
                    "hyprctl", "eval",
                    f"hl.layer_rule({{ match = {{ namespace = 'quickshell:bar' }}, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.0 }}); "
                    f"hl.layer_rule({{ match = {{ namespace = 'quickshell:celestialBezel' }}, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.5 }}); "
                    f"hl.layer_rule({{ match = {{ namespace = 'quickshell:sidebarRight' }}, blur = true, ignore_alpha = 0.0 }}); "
                    f"hl.config({{ decoration = {{ blur = {{ enabled = true, size = {size}, passes = {passes} }} }} }})"
                ], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            except Exception:
                pass
        else:
            try:
                subprocess.Popen([
                    "hyprctl", "eval",
                    "hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'quickshell:bar' }, blur = false }); "
                    "hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'quickshell:celestialBezel' }, blur = false }); "
                    "hl.layer_rule({ match = { namespace = 'quickshell:sidebarRight' }, blur = false })"
                ], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            except Exception:
                pass
        backend.apply_hyprland()

    def _refresh_dock_apps_list(self):
        for row in self.dock_app_rows:
            self.dock_apps_group.remove(row)
        self.dock_app_rows.clear()

        pinned = backend.get("dock.pinnedApps", ["kitty"])
        if not pinned:
            empty_row = Adw.ActionRow(
                title="Belum Ada Aplikasi Default",
                subtitle="Klik ikon tambah (+) di sudut kanan atas untuk menyematkan aplikasi ke dock"
            )
            empty_row.set_sensitive(False)
            self.dock_apps_group.add(empty_row)
            self.dock_app_rows.append(empty_row)
            return

        all_apps = AppDetector.get_all_apps()
        app_map = {a["id"].lower(): a for a in all_apps}
        for a in all_apps:
            if a.get("exec"):
                bin_name = a["exec"].split()[0].split("/")[-1].lower()
                if bin_name and bin_name not in app_map:
                    app_map[bin_name] = a

        max_apps = backend.get("dock.maxApps", 8)

        for idx, app_id in enumerate(pinned):
            app_info = app_map.get(app_id.lower())
            title = app_info["name"] if app_info else app_id.capitalize()
            subtitle = f"{app_id} • Posisi {idx + 1}"
            if idx >= max_apps:
                subtitle += " (Melebihi batas maksimal, tidak tampil di dock)"

            row = Adw.ActionRow(title=title, subtitle=subtitle)

            # Prefix icon
            icon_name = app_info.get("icon", "application-x-executable") if app_info else "application-x-executable"
            img = Gtk.Image()
            img.set_pixel_size(24)
            try:
                gicon = Gio.Icon.new_for_string(icon_name)
                img.set_from_gicon(gicon)
            except Exception:
                img.set_from_icon_name("application-x-executable")
            row.add_prefix(img)

            # Suffix button box
            box = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=4)
            box.set_valign(Gtk.Align.CENTER)

            if idx > 0:
                up_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("go-up-symbolic")
                up_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                up_btn.add_css_class("circular")
                up_btn.set_tooltip_text("Geser ke Kiri / Atas")
                up_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, i=idx: self._move_pinned_app(i, -1))
                box.append(up_btn)

            if idx < len(pinned) - 1:
                down_btn = Gtk.Button.new_from_icon_name("go-down-symbolic")
                down_btn.add_css_class("flat")
                down_btn.add_css_class("circular")
                down_btn.set_tooltip_text("Geser ke Kanan / Bawah")
                down_btn.connect("clicked", lambda b, i=idx: self._move_pinned_app(i, 1))
                box.append(down_btn)

            del_btn.add_css_class("destructive-action")
            del_btn.set_tooltip_text("Hapus dari Aplikasi Default")
